title: Reddit 深度研究报告 - 变现驱动增长与搜索流量依赖的压力测试
titleEn: Reddit Deep Research Report - Monetization-Driven Growth and the Search-Referral Dependency Stress Test
summary: 首次覆盖。Q2 2026 收入 $804.91M（同比 +61%）、净利 $252.85M、摊薄 EPS $1.25、调整后 EBITDA $343M（43% 利润率），全面超预期且 Q3 指引 $860-870M 同样高于预期，但财报后单日跌 21%（上市以来最大跌幅）。核心发现：增长引擎已从用户切换为变现——美国 DAU 环比 53.5M→53.2M 横盘略降，同期美国 ARPU 同比 +51%，本季美国收入增长几乎全部来自单用户变现。Google 数据授权协议（约 $60M/年）2027 上半年到期，同时绑定授权收入与搜索分发。以 2026-07-31 收盘 $140.67、市值约 $27.06B、EV 约 $24.30B 计，TTM P/E 32.8x、EV/Sales 8.7x、FY2026E EV/EBITDA 约 16.8x。情景权重 30/50/20，立场为中性偏积极、低确信。
summaryEn: Initial coverage. Q2 2026 revenue of $804.91M (+61% YoY), net income $252.85M, diluted EPS $1.25, and adjusted EBITDA of $343M (43% margin) all beat, and Q3 guidance of $860-870M also came in above consensus, yet the stock fell 21% on the print — its largest single-day decline since IPO. Core finding: the growth engine has switched from users to monetization — U.S. DAU went 53.5M to 53.2M sequentially (flat to slightly down) while U.S. ARPU rose 51% YoY, so essentially all U.S. revenue growth in the quarter came from per-user monetization. The Google data-licensing agreement (roughly $60M/year) expires in H1 2027 and bundles licensing revenue with search distribution. At the 2026-07-31 close of $140.67, market cap is about $27.06B and EV about $24.30B, for a 32.8x TTM P/E, 8.7x EV/Sales, and roughly 16.8x FY2026E EV/EBITDA. Scenario weights of 30/50/20 support a neutral-to-constructive stance at low conviction.
highlights: 增长换轨：美国 DAU 环比 53.5M→53.2M，同期美国 ARPU $9.63→$11.85（同比 +51%）；按 DAUq×ARPU 还原的收入与公司报告值误差 <0.05%
估值：TTM P/E 32.8x、P/S 9.7x、EV/Sales 8.7x、EV/EBITDA 30.3x；FY2026E EV/EBITDA 约 16.8x；净利含利息收入与低税率加成，跨公司比较需校正
关键风险：Google 授权协议约 $60M/年、2027 上半年到期；公司自 Q3 2026 起停止披露登录/未登录用户拆分
资本配置：$10 亿回购授权，Q2 执行约 150 万股/约 $235M（均价 $157.57，高于现价约 12%），剩余约 $760M

title: ASML 深度研究报告 - EUV / High-NA 作为设备层公共约束
titleEn: ASML Deep Research Report - EUV / High-NA as the Equipment-Layer Common Constraint
summary: AI 基础设施 semicap-equipment 层的公共约束：ASML 验证 foundry / memory capex 是否真正穿过光刻、EUV、High-NA、长期协议和出口管制这道最硬瓶颈。Q2 2026 net sales EUR 9.326B、gross margin 54.0%、net income EUR 2.918B；FY2026 指引第二次上调至 net sales EUR 43-45B、gross margin 54-56%，并计划把 2027 年 low-NA EUV 与 DUV immersion 产能各较 2026 年增加 30%。本次监测没有季度 net bookings 或 backlog 披露，因此只加强设备侧确认，不证明客户特定 capex 已全部承诺。2026-07-31 重新锚定至 2026-07-30 收盘 ADR $1,651.44、市值约 $636.5B、约 14.6x EV/2026E sales；倍数仍高于基准情景所设的高个位数至低十几倍区间，且立场并不主要依赖倍数，维持中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Common-constraint coverage for the AI-infrastructure semicap-equipment layer. ASML tests whether foundry and memory capex truly passes through lithography, EUV, High-NA, long-term agreements, and export controls. Q2 2026 net sales were EUR 9.326B, gross margin was 54.0%, and net income was EUR 2.918B; FY2026 guidance was raised for the second time to EUR 43-45B net sales and 54-56% gross margin, while ASML plans to add 30% to both 2027 low-NA EUV and DUV immersion capacity versus 2026. The update disclosed neither quarterly net bookings nor backlog, so it strengthens equipment-side confirmation without proving that customer-specific capex is fully committed. The $1,651.44 ADR and roughly 14.6x EV/2026E sales remain the dated 2026-07-02 initial valuation snapshot based on the then EUR 36-40B guide; this update does not refresh valuation or stance, which remains neutral watch / medium conviction.
highlights: P2 设备层公共约束：ASML 用 EUV/High-NA、backlog、installed-base service 和出口管制验证 AI capex 是否进入最硬工具瓶颈

upgrade.en: move to constructive if Q2 2026 orders and customer-capacity commentary show EUV / High-NA bookings staying above the FY2026 revenue run-rate, backlog conversion remains on plan, and export-control updates do not reduce the China service or systems opportunity while the valuation multiple does not expand further.

downgrade.en: move to cautious if EUV / High-NA bookings slow, the EUR 38.797B backlog shows cancellation or delay risk, China/export-control limits reduce system or installed-base service access, or gross margin slips below the FY2026 51-53% guide.

title: Applied Materials 深度研究报告 - AI 扩产的广谱半导体设备仪表盘
titleEn: Applied Materials Deep Research Report - Broad Semicap Dashboard For AI Capacity Buildout
summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：AMAT 于 2026-07-30 收于 $501.77，较 07-29 低点反弹 +15.0%、较原锚点 -16.8%，市值约 $398.4B；按所有者 Q1 裁定，立场由谨慎调整为观望中性（中确信）。】AI 基础设施 semicap-equipment 层的广谱设备仪表盘：AMAT 验证 AI 需求是否不只卡在 EUV，而是扩散到 deposition、etch、advanced packaging、DRAM 和服务。FY2026 Q2 收入 $7.91B、GAAP gross margin 49.9%、non-GAAP EPS $2.86；Semiconductor Systems 收入 $5.965B，其中 foundry/logic/other 67%、DRAM 29%。Q3 指引收入 $8.950B +/- $500M、non-GAAP EPS $3.36 +/- $0.20。按 2026-07-30 收盘重算：市值约 $398.4B、EV 约 $397.5B，约 11.1x EV/Q3 annualized sales、约 30.6x forward EPS。观望中性 / 中确信：上行周期强，旧的负偏斜算术在当前价格下不再成立，中国/台湾暴露使其停留在观望。
summaryEn: [2026-07-31 stance re-adjudication: AMAT closed at $501.77 on 2026-07-30, +15.0% off the 07-29 low and -16.8% from its old anchor, for about $398.4B market cap; under the owner's Q1 ruling the stance moves from cautious to neutral-watch (medium conviction).] Broad equipment dashboard for the AI-infrastructure semicap-equipment layer. AMAT tests whether AI demand is spreading beyond EUV into deposition, etch, advanced packaging, DRAM, and services. Q2 FY2026 revenue was $7.91B, GAAP gross margin was 49.9%, and non-GAAP EPS was $2.86; Semiconductor Systems revenue was $5.965B, with foundry/logic/other at 67% and DRAM at 29%. Q3 guidance is $8.950B revenue +/- $500M and non-GAAP EPS of $3.36 +/- $0.20. Recomputed at the 2026-07-30 close: about $398.4B market cap and $397.5B EV, around 11.1x EV/Q3-annualized sales and 30.6x forward EPS. Neutral-watch / medium conviction: the upcycle is strong; the old mildly negative skew no longer holds at the current price, and China/Taiwan exposure keeps this a watch.
highlights: 补齐广谱设备仪表盘：AMAT 验证 AI capex 是否进入 deposition、etch、advanced packaging、DRAM 和服务
FY2026 Q2 revenue $7.91B、Semiconductor Systems $5.965B，foundry/logic/other 67%、DRAM 29%
Q3 指引 revenue $8.950B +/- $500M、non-GAAP EPS $3.36 +/- $0.20
按 2026-07-30 收盘：EV 约 $397.5B、约 11.1x Q3 annualized sales、约 30.6x forward EPS；中国/台湾暴露需要持续监控

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-07-31 按所有者 Q1 裁定重新裁定（立场必须在当前价格下成立）。按 2026-07-30 收盘 $501.77（市值约 $398.4B、EV 约 $397.5B），EV/Q3 年化收入约 11.1x、forward EPS 约 30.6x，而旧谨慎立场依据的是 13.3x/36.8x 的算术；在仅略高于报告自身 8-10x 通周期区间的水平上，轻度负预期差不再成立，立场调整为观望中性。中国/台湾暴露与 2026-08-13 业绩使其停留在观望。
stanceRationale.en: Re-adjudicated 2026-07-31 under the owner's Q1 ruling (a stance must hold at the current price). At the 2026-07-30 close of $501.77 (about $398.4B cap, $397.5B EV), AMAT is at about 11.1x EV/Q3-annualized sales and roughly 30.6x forward EPS versus the old 13.3x/36.8x arithmetic the cautious stance rested on; just above the report's own 8-10x through-cycle band, the mildly negative gap no longer holds, so the stance moves to neutral-watch. China/Taiwan exposure and the 2026-08-13 print keep it a watch.

upgrade.zh: 如果 FY2026 Q3 收入达到或高于 $8.95B 中点、Semiconductor Systems operating margin 维持 35% 以上，foundry/logic 与 DRAM mix 同时强劲，且中国/台湾暴露没有受到出口管制或客户节奏冲击，同时 EV/sales 倍数没有进一步扩张，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: move to constructive if FY2026 Q3 revenue reaches or exceeds the $8.95B midpoint, Semiconductor Systems operating margin stays above 35%, foundry/logic and DRAM mix remain strong together, and China/Taiwan exposure is not hit by export controls or customer timing while the EV/sales multiple does not expand further.

downgrade.zh: 如果 Q3 收入低于中点、Semiconductor Systems 增长或 operating margin 走弱、中国/台湾收入受到出口管制或客户节奏冲击，或库存与供应链扩建转化为去库存压力，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: move to cautious if Q3 revenue misses the midpoint, Semiconductor Systems growth or operating margin weakens, China/Taiwan revenue is hit by export controls or customer timing, or the inventory and supply-chain build turns into destocking pressure.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定：立场须在当前价格下成立。$501.77 下 11.1x EV/年化收入，负预期差算术消失，谨慎调整为观望中性。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling: stance must hold at the current price. At $501.77 (~11.1x EV/annualized sales) the negative-gap arithmetic is gone; cautious moves to neutral-watch.

title: Lam Research 深度研究报告 - AI 内存与先进逻辑的刻蚀/沉积校验
titleEn: Lam Research Deep Research Report - Etch And Deposition Check On AI Memory And Advanced Logic
summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：LRCX 于 2026-07-30 收于 $297.72，较 07-29 低点反弹 +18.0%、较原锚点 -15.3%，市值约 $372.3B；按所有者 Q1 裁定按当前价格复核，维持观望中性（中确信）。】2026-07-30 监测更新：AI 基础设施 semicap-equipment 层的刻蚀/沉积仪表盘。FY2026 Q4（6 月季度，截至 2026-06-28）：营收 $6.72B（环比 +15%、同比 +30%），non-GAAP gross margin 52.0%（GAAP 51.7%）、non-GAAP operating margin 38.4%（GAAP 37.4%）、non-GAAP 摊薄 EPS $1.82（GAAP $1.81）；Systems revenue $4.250B、customer support-related and other revenue $2.472B；deferred revenue 升至 $2.43B。管理层给出 9 月季度（FY2027 Q1）指引：营收 $8.10B +/- $400M、gross margin 52.0% +/- 1%、non-GAAP 摊薄 EPS $2.15 +/- $0.15。公司称创下 revenue、operating margin 与 EPS 纪录，并称广泛的 AI 驱动需求正在重塑半导体市场；新闻稿未把需求具体归因到 NAND、DRAM 或先进逻辑。按 2026-07-30 收盘重算：约 13.8x EV/6 月季度年化收入（旧口径 16.6x 为 2026-07-02 快照）；立场按当前价格复核后维持中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: [2026-07-31 stance re-adjudication: LRCX closed at $297.72 on 2026-07-30, +18.0% off the 07-29 low and -15.3% from its old anchor, for about $372.3B market cap; re-checked at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling, neutral-watch (medium conviction) holds.] July 30, 2026 monitoring update: etch/deposition dashboard for the AI-infrastructure semicap-equipment layer. Recomputed at the 2026-07-30 close: about 13.8x EV/June-quarter-annualized sales (the old 16.6x was the July 2, 2026 snapshot); the stance was re-checked at the current price and stays neutral watch / medium conviction.

summaryEn: Common-constraint coverage for the AI-infrastructure eda-ip layer. SNPS tests whether AI silicon demand is flowing into design automation, verification, simulation, IP blocks, and system-level complexity. Q2 FY2026 revenue was $2.276B versus $1.604B a year ago, GAAP EPS was $0.09, and non-GAAP EPS was $3.35; FY2026 guidance is $9.625-9.705B revenue, $14.72-14.80 non-GAAP EPS, and about $2.0B FCF. Constructive / medium conviction: the multiple compressed in the July 2026 chain repricing so the same guidance frame is cheaper and the modestly positive expectation gap widens, while integration, export, and customer-cycle risks keep conviction capped.

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $332.82、市值约 $91.8B、EV 约 $93.4B 计，对照 2026-07-27 上修后的 FY2026 指引约为 14.8x EV/sales、41.1x non-GAAP P/E，而旧的冻结 2026-07-02 框架为约 16.9x / 47.2x。谨慎判断此前几乎完全建立在“价格已前置资本化大部分好消息”这一估值主张上，而该主张已被价格下行与指引/backlog/RPO 上行两个方向同时消化；熊市情景要求的 backlog 转化延迟、IP 增速不足、Hexagon 稀释 margin 在 Q2 均出现相反证据，因此没有独立执行腿支撑谨慎。立场调整为 neutral-watch；不直接到 constructive，因为 Q3 转化确认尚未到位。
stanceRationale.en: At the $332.82 close on 2026-07-30, about $91.8B market cap and about $93.4B EV, CDNS is roughly 14.8x EV/sales and 41.1x non-GAAP P/E against the FY2026 guide raised on 2026-07-27, versus about 16.9x / 47.2x in the old frozen July 2, 2026 frame. The bear case's conditions (backlog slippage, IP undershoot, Hexagon margin dilution) all ran the other way in Q2, so no independent execution leg sustains the cautious stance. summaryEn: July 30, 2026 monitoring update (Q2 2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026): revenue was $2.625B (+16% YoY, including one-time xScale fees), recurring revenue $2.377B (MRR +11%), AFFO $1.168B (+20%), and AFFO/share $11.78 (+19%); Q2 added a record 9,700 net interconnections and annualized gross bookings were $424M (+23%). Management raised FY2026 guidance and its long-term outlook. Interconnection, bookings, and MRR strengthened together, so the facility-interconnection-leasing falsifier was not triggered; the metrics are consistent with network-dense deployment, but the company did not attribute them specifically to AI and they are not causal proof of AI demand. The $1,047.53 (Jul 30, 2026 close) is the re-anchored valuation basis by this monitoring pass. DLR's paired check in the AI-infrastructure data-center facility layer. EQIX uses Platform Equinix interconnection, retail colocation, xScale JVs and AFFO/share to test whether AI demand is more than hyperscale shell leasing. Q1 2026 revenue was $2.444B (+10% reported YoY), operating income was $577M, net income was $415M, adjusted EBITDA was $1.245B, and AFFO/share was $10.79. MRR grew 12% reported / 10% normalized constant-currency YoY, annualized gross bookings were $378M, annualized presales were about $140M, and about 60% of largest deals were AI-related. The 2025 annual report disclosed 280 data centers, 10,500+ customers and 507,000+ interconnections, while Q1 2026 interconnection revenue was $446M. At $1,047.53 (2026-07-02), about $103.3B market cap and about $125.3B EV, EQIX trades around 24.4x the midpoint of 2026 AFFO/share guidance and about 12.2x 2026 revenue guidance. Neutral watch / medium conviction: high quality but high valuation; key monitors are interconnection revenue, AI bookings/presales, xScale economics, MRR/cabinet yield and power availability.

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $1,047.53、约 24.4x 2026 AFFO/share 指引中点计，市场大致要求 AFFO/share 未来三年约 15% CAGR，同时维持 interconnection 与 xScale 溢价；我们的 30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市情景与此接近，因此维持中性观察。
stanceRationale.en: At $1,047.53 and about 24.4x the midpoint of 2026 AFFO/share guidance, the market is underwriting roughly 15% three-year AFFO/share CAGR while preserving the interconnection and xScale premium; our 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid is close to that, so the stance remains neutral watch.

title: Nebius Group 深度研究报告 - neocloud 的『干净对照组』：对 CoreWeave 风险锚的架构校验
titleEn: Nebius Group Deep Research Report - The 'Clean' Neocloud: An Architecture Check on the CoreWeave Risk Anchor
summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：NBIS 于 2026-07-30 收于 $188.43，较 07-29 低点反弹 +27.1%、较原锚点仅 -11.5%，市值约 $41.6B、P/S（TTM）约 47x；按所有者 Q1 裁定按当前价格复核，维持谨慎（中确信）。】本中心 AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的第二篇，作为对 CoreWeave 风险锚的『交叉校验/架构校验』。前身 Yandex 的国际继承者、阿姆斯特丹总部、纳斯达克上市的全栈 AI 云（neocloud）。与 CoreWeave 相反：Q1 2026 营收 $3.99 亿(+684%)、AI 云 ARR $19.2 亿、调整后 EBITDA 转正 $1.295 亿、经营现金流 +$22.6 亿，靠约 $93 亿现金/客户预付款/可转债、而非 GPU 抵押杠杆融资；约 $84 亿非流动债务与约 $10 亿经营租赁负债，对照约 $93 亿现金，金融债务口径近中性、租赁调整后中性至约 $40 亿净现金（取决于预付认股权证处理）。但 GAAP 净利 $6.21 亿实为一笔 $7.806 亿 ClickHouse 非现金重估（经营层面 −$1.28 亿亏损），且正积累与 CoreWeave 同款的超大规模集中（微软最高约 $194 亿 + Meta 最高约 $270 亿，合计约 $460 亿公司披露承诺/上限）与 NVIDIA 供应商+股东循环性。股价约 $240（2026-07-01，6 月 22 日纳指 100 纳入前后约 $256）、市值约 $610 亿、约 2.539 亿流通股，约 17-19x EV/2026E 营收（约 CoreWeave 的 3 倍）、约 7x EV/退出 ARR；2026 资本开支 $200-250 亿(约 7 倍营收)。核心读数：CoreWeave 的脆弱只是资产负债表选择，还是 neocloud 模式的固有属性？答案——只有偿付脆弱是 CoreWeave 独有，需求/集中/循环/资本开支风险是全层共享。2026-07-07 v5 更新：以 2026-07-06 收盘 旧锚点价格（已移除） 为锚，30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市情景网格给出略偏负预期差，当前迁移为谨慎 / 中确信。2026-07-17 监测更新：公司签订首笔约 $7.75 亿资产级担保融资；客户未具名，可复制性仍是公司预期，本次不刷新 2026-07-06 估值快照或谨慎 / 中确信立场。
highlights: demand-risk 层第二篇，作为 CoreWeave 风险锚的『架构校验』对照组：一朵用现金/预付款/可转债、而非 GPU 抵押债融资的 neocloud——检验 CoreWeave 的脆弱是模式性的还是资产负债表性的
与 CoreWeave 相反的报表：Q1 2026 营收 $3.99 亿(+684%)、AI 云 ARR $19.2 亿、调整后 EBITDA 转正 $1.295 亿(集团 32%/云 45%)、经营现金流 +$22.6 亿；约 $93 亿现金 vs 约 $84 亿非流动债务 + 约 $10 亿经营租赁负债，金融债务口径近中性、租赁调整后仍显著更轻
但两条警报：GAAP 净利 $6.21 亿实为 $7.806 亿 ClickHouse 非现金重估(经营层面仍 −$1.28 亿亏损)；集中度与循环性在向 CoreWeave 收敛(微软最高约 $194 亿 + Meta 最高约 $270 亿，公司披露承诺/上限；NVIDIA 供应商+$20 亿股东)
股价约 $240(2026-07-01；6 月 22 日纳指 100 纳入前后约 $256)、市值约 $610 亿、约 2.539 亿流通股；约 17-19x EV/2026E 营收(约 CoreWeave 3 倍)、约 7x EV/退出 ARR；2026 资本开支 $200-250 亿(约 7 倍营收)。高质量但高预期/高风险(观察)
summaryEn: [2026-07-31 stance re-adjudication: NBIS closed at $188.43 on 2026-07-30, +27.1% off the 07-29 low and only -11.5% from its old anchor, for about $41.6B market cap and ~47x P/S (TTM); re-checked at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling, cautious (medium conviction) holds.] The second report in this center's AI-infra demand-risk layer, serving as the cross-check ('architecture check') on the CoreWeave risk anchor. Nebius is the Amsterdam-HQ, NASDAQ-listed, full-stack AI-cloud (neocloud) successor to the former Yandex. It is CoreWeave's mirror image: Q1 2026 revenue $399.0M (+684%), AI-cloud ARR $1.92B, adjusted EBITDA turned positive at $129.5M, and +$2.3B operating cash flow — funded by ~$9.3B cash, customer prepayments and convertibles rather than GPU-collateralized leverage, with ~$8.4B non-current debt plus ~$1.0B operating lease liabilities against ~$9.3B cash (financial-debt near-neutral; lease-adjusted neutral to ~$4B net cash depending on prefunded-warrant treatment). But GAAP net income of $621M is a $780.6M non-cash ClickHouse revaluation over a −$128M operating loss, and Nebius is accumulating the same hyperscaler concentration (Microsoft up to ~$19.4B + Meta up to ~$27B, ~$46B company-disclosed commitments/ceilings) and the same NVIDIA supplier-shareholder circularity as CoreWeave. Stock ~$240 (2026-07-01; ~$256 around its June-22 Nasdaq-100 inclusion), market cap ~$61B on ~253.9M shares outstanding, ~17-19x EV/2026E revenue (~3x CoreWeave's) and ~7x EV/exit-ARR; 2026 capex $20-25B (~7x revenue). Core read-through: is CoreWeave's fragility a balance-sheet choice or inherent to the neocloud model? Only the solvency fragility is CoreWeave-specific; the demand/concentration/circularity/capex risks are shared across the layer. Jul 7, 2026 v5 update: anchored to the Jul 6, 2026 close of 旧锚点价格（已移除）, the 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear scenario grid leaves a slightly negative expectation gap; stance migrates to cautious / medium conviction. Jul. 17, 2026 monitoring update: Nebius entered its first approximately $775M asset-level secured facility; the customer is unnamed and repeatability remains an issuer expectation. This update does not refresh the Jul. 6 valuation snapshot or the cautious / medium-conviction stance.

The customer is unnamed; the issuer separately says the structure could be repeated against >$40B of additional contracted revenue from customers such as Microsoft/Meta, but that remains a future financing expectation. stanceRationale.zh: 2026-07-31 按所有者 Q1 裁定以当前价格复核。按 2026-07-30 收盘 $188.43（+27.1%，本集合最大反弹；距旧锚点仅 -11.5%），市值约 $41.6B、P/S（TTM）约 47.3x：反弹基本恢复了原前提——市场重新在为"胜出独立 neocloud + 非核心期权"付费——因此谨慎立场在当前价格下成立；集中度、capex 融资与剔除重估利润折价依然适用。
stanceRationale.en: Re-checked 2026-07-31 at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the 2026-07-30 close of $188.43 (+27.1%, the largest bounce in this set; only -11.5% from the old anchor), market cap is about $41.6B and P/S (TTM) about 47.3x: the bounce essentially restored the premise — the market is again paying for the winning-neocloud-plus-optionality story — so cautious holds as a current-price judgment; concentration, capex financing and the profit-ex-marks discount still apply.

upgrade.en: Microsoft / Meta contracts convert into high-utilization revenue on schedule, 2026 exit ARR lands in the middle-to-high end of the $7-9B range, operating profit ex-marks stays positive, capex funding does not require dilution on worse terms, and customer concentration does not keep converging toward the CoreWeave profile

downgrade.zh: 微软或 Meta 放量延迟，合同 ABS/预付款融资成本明显恶化，剔除重估利润重新转负，非核心期权重估回撤，或客户集中度与 NVIDIA 循环性继续上升并削弱独立 neocloud 叙事
downgrade.en: Microsoft or Meta ramps are delayed, contract ABS / prepayment funding costs materially worsen, operating profit ex-marks turns negative again, non-core optionality marks reverse, or customer concentration and NVIDIA circularity keep rising and weaken the independent-neocloud story

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定复核：$188.43 下 P/S 约 47x，原前提被反弹恢复，谨慎按当前价格成立。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling re-check: at $188.43 (P/S ~47x) the bounce restored the premise; cautious holds at the current price.

title: Arista Networks 深度研究报告 - AI 集群开放以太网 fabric 的系统软件卖铲人
titleEn: Arista Networks Deep Research Report - The Open Ethernet Fabric of AI Clusters
summary: AI 集群网络层首次覆盖：Arista 是开放以太网/AI spine/scale-out 网络的系统软件卖铲人，正面回答 NVIDIA Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink 一体化 vs Broadcom merchant silicon + Arista EOS/CloudVision/800G Ethernet 生态的路线之争。Q1 2026 营收 $2.709B(+35.1%)、GAAP/非GAAP营业利润率 42.7%/47.8%、非GAAP EPS $0.87、经营现金流 $1.69B；Q2 指引营收约 $2.8B。FY2025 Cloud and AI Titans/AI Specialty Providers 占收入 48%/20%，Core AI/Cloud/Data Center Networking 占 65%。但两大匿名终端客户合计约 42% 收入(26%/16%)、高度依赖 Broadcom merchant silicon，且 Jun 29 2026 市值约 $206.6B、约 58x TTM GAAP P/E、约 49x 当前非GAAP EPS运行率。neutral-watch / 中等确信：高质量，但大多已定价。
highlights: AI 集群网络层补位：ANET 不是光模块/光纤层，而是开放以太网交换系统、EOS、CloudVision、遥测与 AI fabric 控制点；可交叉校验 NVDA/AVGO/AAOI/GLW/VRT/CRWV
Q1 2026 营收 $2.709B(+35.1%)、非GAAP营业利润率 47.8%、非GAAP EPS $0.87、经营现金流 $1.69B；现金+可交易证券约 $12.35B、基本无债，Q2 指引收入约 $2.8B
路线之争：NVIDIA 一体化网络栈(Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink) vs Broadcom merchant silicon + Arista EOS/CloudVision/800G Ethernet；ANET 更像 Broadcom 生态客户/伙伴，而非直接替代
neutral-watch / 中等确信：价格约 $171.02、约 21x EV/TTM 收入，市场已要求多年高 20% 至 30% 中段增长与优秀利润率，等待更好价格或更强开放以太网份额证据
summaryEn: Initial coverage of the AI cluster networking layer: Arista is the open Ethernet / AI spine / scale-out systems-software pick-and-shovel, directly testing NVIDIA Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink integration vs Broadcom merchant silicon + Arista EOS/CloudVision/800G Ethernet. Q1 2026 revenue was $2.709B (+35.1%), GAAP/non-GAAP operating margin 42.7%/47.8%, non-GAAP EPS $0.87, and operating cash flow $1.69B; Q2 guide is about $2.8B revenue. FY2025 Cloud and AI Titans / AI Specialty Providers were 48%/20% of revenue, and Core AI/Cloud/Data Center Networking was 65%. But two anonymous end customers were ~42% of revenue (26%/16%), Arista is highly reliant on Broadcom merchant silicon, and at the Jun 29 2026 market cap of ~$206.6B the stock trades around 58x TTM GAAP earnings and ~49x current non-GAAP EPS run-rate. Neutral-watch / medium conviction: high quality, but mostly priced in.

stanceRationale.zh: 在 $171.02、约 21x EV/TTM 收入上，市场大致要求未来数年收入维持约 30% 至 38% 复合增长并保持优秀利润率；我们的基准情景接近这个区间低端，因此维持中性观察。
stanceRationale.en: At $171.02 and about 21x EV/TTM revenue, the market is underwriting roughly roughly 30% to 38% revenue CAGR for several years with elite margins; our base case is close to the low end of that range, so the stance remains neutral watch.

upgrade.zh: 若 Q2/Q3 财报使收入增速保持在高 20% 以上、非 GAAP 营业利润率维持 45% 以上、递延收入/RPO 扩张，并且客户证据显示开放以太网在 AI 后端网络份额提升且集中度未进一步上升，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: move to constructive if Q2/Q3 results keep revenue growth above the high-20s, non-GAAP operating margin stays above 45%, deferred revenue/RPO expands, and customer evidence shows open Ethernet gaining AI back-end share without higher concentration.

downgrade.zh: 若收入增速跌破隐含的高 20% 路径、非 GAAP 营业利润率在缺少明确投资解释的情况下低于 40%、头部客户集中度恶化，或 NVIDIA 一体化网络在 AI 后端拿到更清楚份额，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: move to cautious if revenue growth falls below the implied high-20s path, non-GAAP operating margin drops below 40% without clear investment explanation, top-customer concentration worsens, or NVIDIA integrated networking takes clearer AI back-end share.

title: CoreWeave 深度研究报告 - AI 建设的风险锚：真实需求还是杠杆与循环融资？
titleEn: CoreWeave Deep Research Report - The AI Buildout's Risk Anchor: Real Demand or Leverage & Circular Financing?
summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：CRWV 于 2026-07-30 收于 $73.90，较 07-29 低点反弹 +21.5%、较原锚点 -14.5%，市值约 $33.1B、EV 约 $66.0B；按所有者 Q1 裁定按当前价格复核，维持 bearish-avoid（中确信）——空头论点锚定在 EV 与结构，而 EV 仅较锚点约 -8%。】本中心 AI 基础设施书的『风险锚』，刻意以熊市为主轴写。GPU『neocloud』，一边是 $994 亿公司定义收入 backlog（RPO + 其他承诺客户合同金额）与 56% 调整后 EBITDA，一边是扩大的 GAAP 净亏损（Q1 2026 −$7.4 亿）、约 $249 亿债务、约 $100 亿经营租赁负债、$310-350 亿 2026 资本开支（约 3 倍营收）。客户集中（微软历史上收入占比 >60%；CNBC 引 2024 年为 62%），NVIDIA 同时是供应商+股东（$20 亿@$87）+$63 亿产能兜底（循环性）。Q1 2026 营收 $20.78 亿(+112%)，FY2026 指引营收 $120-130 亿。股价已较 2025 峰值回落约 47% 至约 $96、市值约 $520 亿、经营租赁前金融净债务约 $229 亿、含经营租赁净义务栈约 $329 亿。中心问题：是真实经济需求还是被杠杆催起的提前囤货？2026-07-07 v5 更新：以 2026-07-06 收盘 旧锚点价格（已移除） 为锚，20% 牛市 / 30% 基准 / 50% 熊市情景网格给出负预期差，维持 bearish-avoid / 中确信。
highlights: 本中心 AI 基础设施书的『风险锚』，以熊市为主轴：检验 AI 建设是真实经济需求、还是被杠杆与循环融资吹起的提前囤货——四条 kill-criterion 的读数回传整本书
矛盾核心：$994 亿公司定义收入 backlog + 56% 调整后 EBITDA vs 扩大的 GAAP 净亏损(Q1'26 −$7.4 亿)、约 $249 亿债务、约 $100 亿经营租赁负债、$310-350 亿 2026 资本开支(约 3 倍营收)；GPU 6 年折旧寿命有争议
循环性：微软历史上收入占比 >60%；NVIDIA 是供应商+股东($20 亿@$87)+$63 亿产能兜底(最后买家至 2032)；微软自建(MAI)、OpenAI 分散、Core Scientific 收购被否

summaryEn: [2026-07-31 stance re-adjudication: CRWV closed at $73.90 on 2026-07-30, +21.5% off the 07-29 low and -14.5% from its old anchor, for about $33.1B market cap and ~$66.0B EV; re-checked at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling, bearish-avoid (medium conviction) holds — the bear case is EV-anchored and EV is only ~-8% from the anchor.] The AI-infra book's 'risk anchor', written deliberately bear-led. A GPU 'neocloud' that pairs a $99.4B company-defined revenue backlog (RPO plus other committed-contract amounts) and 56% adjusted EBITDA with a widening GAAP net loss (Q1 2026 -$740M), ~$24.9B debt, ~$10.1B operating lease liabilities, and $31-35B of 2026 capex (~3x revenue). Customer-concentrated (Microsoft historically >60% of revenue; CNBC cited 62% for 2024); NVIDIA is supplier + shareholder ($2B at $87) + $6.3B capacity backstop (circularity). Q1 2026 revenue $2.078B (+112%); FY2026 guide revenue $12-13B. The stock is already ~47% off 2025 peaks at ~$96, market cap ~$52B, financial net debt ~$22.9B before operating leases and ~$32.9B net obligation stack incl. operating leases. Central question: real economic demand or leverage-fueled pre-stocking? Jul 7, 2026 v5 update: anchored to the Jul 6, 2026 close of the old anchor price (removed), the 20% bull / 30% base / 50% bear scenario grid leaves a negative expectation gap; stance remains bearish-avoid / medium conviction.

summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：VRT 于 2026-07-30 收于 $227.50，较 07-29 低点仅反弹 +2.0%、较原锚点 -25.9%，市值约 $87.4B、按上调后指引约 34x 前瞻调整后 EPS；按所有者 Q1 裁定，立场由谨慎调整为观望中性（中确信）。】2026-07-30 监测更新（Q2 2026，季度截至 2026-06-30）：净销售额 $32.74亿（+24%、有机 +18%），调整后营业利润率 22.6%（+410bps），摊薄 EPS $1.27（+53%）、调整后摊薄 EPS $1.52（+60%），经营现金流 $11.0亿、调整后 FCF $9.25亿（+234%）。管理层全面上调 FY2026 指引：净销售额 $138-142亿（有机 +31%）、调整后 EPS $6.65-6.75、调整后 FCF $24-26亿。该财报未量化本季订单/backlog。估值与立场已于 2026-07-31 按当前收盘重新裁定。数据中心电力与热管理（含液冷）卖铲人，位于『电从哪来』(GEV/Bloom)与『芯片』(NVDA/AVGO)之间，是 AI 建设速度最实时的『仪表盘』。Q1 2026 营收$26.5亿(+30%，有机+23%、美洲有机+44%)、调整后营业利润率20.8%(+430bps)、调整后EPS $1.17(+83%)、调整后FCF $6.53亿(+147%)；最新披露的 Q4 2025 backlog $150亿(+109%)、book-to-bill ~2.9x。FY2026指引上调至营收$135-140亿、调整后EPS $6.30-6.40。按 2026-07-30 收盘 $227.50：市值约 $87.4B、约 34x 上调后前瞻调整后 EPS（旧口径 ~48 倍/~$1,179 亿已被取代），反向倍数框架仅隐含约 10% EPS 复合增速。观望中性 / 中确信：旧的"近乎完美建设节奏"门槛已不成立；高 beta 订单簿与未量化的订单/backlog 披露是观察项。

summaryEn: [2026-07-31 stance re-adjudication: VRT closed at $227.50 on 2026-07-30, only +2.0% off the 07-29 low and -25.9% from its old anchor, for about $87.4B market cap and ~34x the raised forward adjusted-EPS guide; under the owner's Q1 ruling the stance moves from cautious to neutral-watch (medium conviction).] July 30, 2026 monitoring update (Q2 2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026): net sales were $3.274B (+24%, +18% organic), adjusted operating margin 22.6% (+410bps), diluted EPS $1.27 (+53%) and adjusted diluted EPS $1.52 (+60%), operating cash flow $1.10B, and adjusted FCF $925M (+234%). Management raised FY2026 guidance across all metrics: net sales $13.8-14.2B (+31% organic), adjusted EPS $6.65-6.75, and adjusted FCF $2.4-2.6B. The release did not quantify this quarter's orders/backlog. The valuation and stance were re-adjudicated 2026-07-31 at the current close. Power & thermal (incl. liquid cooling) pick-and-shovel for data centers, sitting between 'where power comes from' (GEV/Bloom) and 'the chips' (NVDA/AVGO) — the most real-time 'dashboard' of AI buildout velocity. Q1 2026 revenue $2.65B (+30%, +23% organic, Americas +44%), adj operating margin 20.8% (+430bps), adj EPS $1.17 (+83%), adj FCF $653M (+147%); latest disclosed Q4 2025 backlog was $15.0B (+109%) with book-to-bill ~2.9x. FY2026 guidance raised to revenue $13.5-14.0B, adj EPS $6.30-6.40. At the 2026-07-30 close of $227.50: about $87.4B market cap and ~34x the raised forward adjusted-EPS guide (the old ~48x / ~$117.9B caliber is superseded); the reverse-multiple frame implies only ~10% EPS CAGR. Neutral-watch / medium conviction: the old near-perfect-buildout bar no longer holds; the high-beta order book and the unquantified orders/backlog disclosure are the watch items.

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-07-31 按所有者 Q1 裁定重新裁定。按 2026-07-30 收盘 $227.50（仅 +2.0%，几乎未参与反弹；市值约 $87.4B），按上调后 FY2026 指引（$6.65-6.75）前瞻约 34x；反向倍数框架（三年向约 32x 正常化、8% 要求回报）现仅隐含约 10% EPS 复合增速，而旧门槛约 24%——使立场转为谨慎的负预期差已消失，立场调整为观望中性；未量化的订单/backlog 披露与高 beta 订单簿是观察项。
stanceRationale.en: Re-adjudicated 2026-07-31 under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the 2026-07-30 close of $227.50 (only +2.0%; about $87.4B cap) and about 34x the raised FY2026 guide ($6.65-6.75), the reverse-multiple frame (normalize toward ~32x over three years at an 8% required return) now implies roughly 10% EPS CAGR versus the old ~24% bar — the negative gap that made the stance cautious is gone, so it moves to neutral-watch; the unquantified orders/backlog disclosure and the high-beta order book are watch items.

upgrade.zh: 如果 Q2/Q3 orders/book-to-bill 维持 >1.5x、backlog 继续增长、液冷/电力设备份额提升且调整后营业利润率高于 23% 指引轨迹，同时前瞻倍数没有继续扩张，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to constructive if Q2/Q3 orders/book-to-bill stays above 1.5x, backlog keeps growing, liquid-cooling/power-equipment share improves, and adjusted operating margin runs above the 23% guide path without further forward-multiple expansion.

downgrade.zh: 如果 orders/book-to-bill 接近或低于 1x、backlog 开始回落、液冷竞争压低毛利/增量利润率，或 hyperscaler capex 指引进入消化期，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to cautious if orders/book-to-bill approaches or falls below 1x, backlog starts rolling over, liquid-cooling competition compresses gross or incremental margin, or hyperscaler capex guidance enters a digestion phase.

note.zh: 所有者 Q1 裁定：$227.50 下前瞻约 34x、隐含仅约 10% CAGR，负预期差消失，谨慎调整为观望中性。
note.en: Owner Q1 ruling: at $227.50 (~34x forward, ~10% implied CAGR) the negative gap is gone; cautious moves to neutral-watch.

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $195.04、约 $4.74T 市值和 mid-20s forward P/E 计，市场定价的是 accelerator profit pool 持续扩张，而不只是泛泛的 AI CAGR；我们的基准情景认为 rack/system attach、networking/software moat 与年度平台节奏仍能保护盈利分母，同时 custom ASIC 和 China 风险尚未足以抵消该优势。
stanceRationale.en: At $195.04, roughly $4.74T market cap, and a mid-20s forward P/E, the market is pricing continued accelerator profit-pool expansion rather than a generic AI CAGR; our base case sees rack/system attach, networking/software moat, and the annual platform cadence still protecting the earnings denominator, while custom ASIC and China risks are not yet large enough to offset that advantage.

upgrade.en: Move to bullish if Q2 FY2027 delivers the $91.0B revenue guide, Data Center sequential slope and 75% non-GAAP gross margin both hold, rack/system attach and networking/software attach expand the profit pool, and ASIC/China/circular-financing risks do not rise.

stanceRationale.en: At $981.98, roughly $264B market cap, and about 44x 2026E adjusted EBITDA, the market already capitalizes gas-turbine slots, the $163B backlog, grid capex, and the margin ramp; a 20% bull / 50% base / 30% bear grid shows very high asset quality but a mildly negative skew from valuation and AI-capex crowding.

upgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch or constructive only after a current valuation review if Q3/Q4 orders and backlog keep growing, the 63 GW of Q2 slot reservations convert into equipment backlog while the combined total progresses toward >=125 GW, adjusted EBITDA margin moves above the 12-14% guide range with clear Wind loss reduction, and the valuation multiple does not expand further.

downgrade.zh: 在完成当前论点/估值复核后，如果数据中心订单或slot转化放缓、利润率爬坡停滞在12-14%以下、Wind亏损未能向维持不变的FY2026指引改善，或AI capex预期下修导致明确标注日期的约45-48x EV/2026E EBITDA重新定价，则下调至bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid after a current thesis/valuation review if data-center orders or slot conversion slow, the margin ramp stalls below the 12-14% guide range, Wind losses fail to improve toward the maintained FY2026 guide, or AI capex expectations are cut and the dated roughly 45-48x EV/2026E EBITDA multiple re-rates.

summary: 2026H1 全周期重写，把 Amazon 升级为 AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的 dashboard 节点。2026 Q2（截至 06-30、07-30 盘后发布）：营收 $200.606B（+20%），AWS $42.232B（+37%、18 季最快、年化运行率 $169B）、分部营业利润 $16.621B / 利润率 39.4%，合并营业利润 $27.461B、利润率创纪录 13.7%，广告 +26%。净利润 $62.647B 含 $53.415B 非经营性其他收益（主要为 Anthropic 重估），不代表经营盈利。TTM 经营现金流 $161.403B，但 PP&E 净购置 $169.007B 使 TTM 自由现金流降至 -$7.604B；据电话会报道全年现金资本开支指引由约 $200B 上调至约 $220B，其中约 $20B 归因于内存涨价而非产能，AWS backlog 达 $496B。估值锚为 2026-07-30 收盘 $235.50，该价格早于盘后财报数小时：市值约 $2.539T、窄口径 EV 约 $2.545T、EV/TTM 销售额约 3.28x（含长期租赁约 3.40x）。30/40/30 情景网格在这个新闻前锚点上读出温和为正的预期差，立场偏多、中确信。
summaryEn: 2026H1 full-cycle rewrite that promotes Amazon into the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer as its dashboard node. Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, reported after the July 30 close): revenue $200.606B (+20%); AWS $42.232B (+37%, fastest in 18 quarters, a $169B annualized run rate) with $16.621B segment operating income at a 39.4% margin; consolidated operating income $27.461B at a record 13.7% margin; advertising +26%. Net income of $62.647B includes $53.415B of non-operating other income, primarily Anthropic marks, and is not an operating-earnings measure. TTM operating cash flow was $161.403B, but $169.007B of net PP&E purchases drove TTM free cash flow to -$7.604B; per earnings-call coverage the full-year cash-capex guide was raised from about $200B to about $220B with roughly $20B attributed to higher memory prices rather than capacity, and the AWS backlog reached $496B. latest.zh: TTM 自由现金流由 FY2025 年末的 +$11.194B 降至 2026 Q2 的 -$7.604B（TTM 经营现金流 $161.403B − PP&E 净购置 $169.007B）；长期债务半年内由 $65.648B 增至 $128.894B，TTM 长期债务发行所得 $81.925B。上一周期的 2026 下半年修复预期未兑现，且资本开支仍在环比上行

latest.zh: 据财报电话会报道，2026 全年现金资本开支指引由约 $200B 上调至约 $220B，增量归因于内存价格上涨；官方财报稿未发布资本开支总额或该归因，但其指引风险因子首次点名「资源与供给波动，包括内存芯片」。量价拆分未披露
latest.en: per earnings-call coverage the 2026 cash-capex guide was raised from about $200B to about $220B with the increase attributed to higher memory prices; the official release publishes neither the capex total nor that attribution, though its guidance risk factors now name resource and supply volatility including memory chips. No unit-versus-price split is disclosed

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q4 财报的 2027 资本开支指引与内存厂商价格表述 / 2027 capex guidance at Q4 2026 results and memory-vendor pricing commentary

metric.zh: Anthropic 重估规模与交易对手循环性

trigger.zh: Anthropic 相关重估出现实质性回撤，或披露显示 AWS backlog 与该交易对手的集中度过高，而公司仍不披露头寸规模
trigger.en: an Anthropic-related mark reverses materially, or disclosure shows excessive AWS-backlog concentration on that counterparty while the position size stays undisclosed

latest.zh: 2026 Q2 非经营性其他收益 $53.415B，财报稿归因为「主要来自我们对 Anthropic 的投资」；同期其他综合收益含 $41.988B 税后可供出售未实现收益（公司未归因），「其他资产」半年内由 $122.607B 增至 $284.132B。账面价值与集中度均未披露；Anthropic 同时承诺最高 5 GW Trainium 产能（电话会报道）

Neither carrying value nor backlog concentration is disclosed; Anthropic has separately committed to as much as 5 GW of Trainium capacity (call coverage)

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q3 起的 10-Q / 10-K 头寸与集中度披露 / 10-Q and 10-K position and concentration disclosure from Q3 2026

trigger.zh: backlog 增速转为个位数、绝对额下降，或 backlog 增长与 AWS 报告收入之间出现持续背离
trigger.en: backlog growth decelerates to single digits, the absolute figure declines, or a sustained divergence opens between backlog growth and reported AWS revenue

latest.zh: 据财报电话会报道，2026 Q2 AWS backlog 达 $496B、以三位数百分比增长，约为 AWS TTM 收入 $148.404B 的 3.3 倍；管理层称 2027 年产能已大部分被预订、2028 年部分产能已被认领。官方财报稿未披露 backlog
latest.en: per earnings-call coverage the Q2 2026 AWS backlog reached $496B growing at triple-digit percentages, roughly 3.3x AWS TTM revenue of $148.404B; management said 2027 capacity is largely reserved with some 2028 capacity spoken for. The official release does not disclose backlog

monitoring.nextCheck: 各季 backlog 披露与 AWS 收入转化 / quarterly backlog disclosure and AWS revenue conversion

metric.zh: Trainium 对商用加速器的替代

trigger.zh: Trainium 部署规模明显超出当前承诺节奏、压制 AWS 内部的商用 GPU 份额，或反向出现 Trainium 承诺被推迟、缩减、取消
trigger.en: Trainium deployment materially outruns the current commitment cadence and displaces merchant-GPU share inside AWS, or conversely Trainium commitments are delayed, cut, or cancelled

latest.zh: 官方财报稿：芯片业务年化收入运行率超过 $25B、三位数增长；Anthropic 与 OpenAI 各自做出多年期多吉瓦级 Trainium 承诺；Graviton5 全面上市、覆盖前 1,000 大 EC2 客户的 98%、收入承诺环比增长近 3 倍。据电话会报道，Trainium 收入承诺超过 $225B，OpenAI 承诺约 2 GW 并自 2027 年起爬坡。尚无可用于分级的部署量或份额披露
latest.en: official release: the chips business exceeded a $25B annual revenue run rate at triple-digit growth; Anthropic and OpenAI each made multi-year, multi-gigawatt Trainium commitments; Graviton5 reached general availability at 98% of the top 1,000 EC2 customers with revenue commitments up nearly 3x sequentially. Per call coverage, Trainium revenue commitments exceed $225B and OpenAI committed to roughly 2 GW ramping from 2027. No deployment-volume or share disclosure exists yet to grade against

monitoring.nextCheck: Trainium 部署披露与 OpenAI 自 2027 年起的爬坡 / Trainium deployment disclosures and the OpenAI ramp from 2027

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $235.50（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市值约 $2.539T、EV/TTM 销售额约 3.28x（含长期租赁约 3.40x）、市值/TTM 经营现金流约 15.7x；18.9x 的 GAAP 市盈率因投资重估而不具决策价值。关键在于这个锚点比盘后财报早了数小时：它没有包含 AWS +37%、39.4% 分部利润率、$496B backlog，也没有包含上调后的约 $220B 资本开支与 -$7.604B 的 TTM 自由现金流。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格在这个新闻前锚点上读出温和为正的预期差 —— 足以支持偏多，但负面项在结构上比表面更糟（约 $20B 的资本开支增量买不到产能，39.4% 是折旧浪潮前的数字），因此不到 bullish。
stanceRationale.en: At $235.50 (2026-07-30 close) market cap is about $2.539T, EV/TTM sales about 3.28x (about 3.40x including long-term leases), and price/TTM operating cash flow about 15.7x; the 18.9x GAAP P/E is not decision-useful because of investment marks. What matters is that this anchor was set hours before the after-close release: it contains neither AWS +37%, the 39.4% segment margin, and the $496B backlog, nor the raised ~$220B capex guide and the -$7.604B TTM free cash flow. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid reads a modestly positive expectation gap at that pre-news anchor - enough for constructive, but not bullish, because the negatives are structurally worse than they look: roughly $20B of the capex increase buys no capacity, and the 39.4% margin is a pre-depreciation-wave figure.

upgrade.zh: 追溯自由现金流在 2026 年见底并于 2027 年内转正，同时 AWS 维持 30% 以上增速与 37% 以上分部利润率，$496B backlog 在 AWS 报告收入中可见地转化，且 2027 资本开支指引把产能与投入成本通胀分开列示，则上调至 bullish。
upgrade.en: TTM free cash flow troughs in 2026 and turns positive during 2027 while AWS holds growth above 30% with a segment margin above 37%, the $496B backlog converts visibly into reported AWS revenue, and the 2027 capex guide separates capacity from input-cost inflation - upgrade to bullish.

downgrade.zh: AWS 增速减至 20% 中段而资本开支仍在上行、AWS 分部利润率跌破 35%、追溯自由现金流在 2027 年前持续低于 -$25B 且长期债务仍在增长，或 Anthropic 相关重估出现实质性回撤而公司仍未披露该头寸规模，则下调至 neutral-watch。
downgrade.en: AWS growth decelerates to the mid-20s while capex still rises, the AWS segment margin breaks below 35%, TTM free cash flow stays below -$25B into 2027 with long-term debt still growing, or an Anthropic-related mark reverses materially without disclosure of the position's size - downgrade to neutral-watch.

At the 2026-07-30 close of $2.13 (about $91M cap, ~5.1x TTM sales): a sub-$100M micro-cap's price carries little information; cautious rests on sequential revenue contraction, dilution, losses and cash-runway risk against Georgia / Infinite Grid optionality, none of which the price move touched, so cautious / low conviction holds.

At the $485.39 close on 2026-07-30, about $792B EV, and roughly 21.2x EV/TTM Sales, the market still prices Meta/Helios, MI450, ROCm improvement, Data Center growth, and margin expansion; annualized Q1 non-GAAP EPS is still about 89x with a roughly 1.3% FCF yield. latest.en: CUDA has roughly 4M developers against ROCm's 100K target for 2026 (about 1/40); the real-world performance gap narrowed from roughly 40-50% to roughly 10-30%, and AMD typically prices roughly 15-40% below NVIDIA to win deals. NVIDIA's AI accelerator share was roughly 86-90% in 2025, while AMD lost about one point of data-center share year over year

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026-H2 迁移案例与 Helios/MI450 出货证据 / H2 2026 migration cases and Helios/MI450 shipment evidence

trigger.zh: 约 23.4x EV/TTM Sales、价格接近 bull case 下沿时的倍数压缩
trigger.en: multiple compression from ~23.4x EV/TTM Sales with price near the bull-case floor

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026-Q2 财报 / Q2 earnings

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 收盘 $485.39、约 $7,920 亿 EV 和约 21.2x EV/TTM Sales 计，市场依然把 Meta/Helios、MI450、ROCm 改善、Data Center 增速和利润率扩张放进价格：按 Q1 Non-GAAP EPS 年化约 89x、即使按 FY2026 $6.00 仍约 81x、FCF 收益率仅约 1.3%。基准情景同意基本面变强，但这些证据仍不足以覆盖当前 multiple，预期差仍偏负。需要指出：倍数由 23.4x 降至 21.2x 完全来自股价下跌，并非升级触发条件所要求的“被收入分母消化”，因此不构成上调理由。
stanceRationale.en: At the $485.39 close on 2026-07-30, roughly $792B EV, and about 21.2x EV/TTM Sales, the market still prices Meta/Helios, MI450, ROCm improvement, Data Center growth, and margin expansion: annualized Q1 non-GAAP EPS is about 89x, about 81x even on $6.00 of FY2026 EPS, and the FCF yield is only about 1.3%. The base case agrees fundamentals are stronger, but that evidence still does not cover the current multiple, so the expectation gap stays negative. Note explicitly that the fall from 23.4x to 21.2x comes entirely from a lower share price and is not the absorption 'by the revenue denominator' the upgrade trigger requires, so it is not a reason to upgrade.

upgrade.zh: 若 2026H2 首个 1GW Meta deployment 按期出货并进入收入、Data Center 增速和 56%+ non-GAAP gross margin 同时兑现，ROCm/Helios 证明可重复客户迁移，且 EV/TTM Sales 从当前约 21.2x 被收入分母消化（股价下跌造成的倍数下降不算），则上调至 neutral-watch 或 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch or constructive if the first 1GW Meta deployment ships on schedule in H2 2026 and enters revenue, Data Center growth and 56%+ non-GAAP gross margin both deliver, ROCm/Helios prove repeatable customer migration, and EV/TTM Sales is absorbed from the current roughly 21.2x by the revenue denominator (a multiple decline caused by a falling share price does not count).

downgrade.zh: 若 Meta 1GW 或 6GW 路径延期/缩小、Data Center 增速低于公司整体、ROCm 没有可审计迁移证据，或 custom ASIC/NVIDIA Rubin 压缩 AMD 的 rack-level 性价比窗口，则下调至 bearish-avoid。
downgrade.en: Move to bearish-avoid if the Meta 1GW or 6GW path is delayed/reduced, Data Center growth falls below company-level growth, ROCm lacks auditable migration evidence, or custom ASICs / NVIDIA Rubin compress AMD's rack-level price-performance window.

stanceRationale.en: At the RMB 64.30 close on 2026-07-31, roughly RMB 29.6B market cap, about 66x Q1-annualized P/E, and about 4.9x P/S, the market is still pre-paying for AIDC / SST / overseas expansion and H-share financing improvement, but much less than at the old anchor: the upside scenario's RMB 35-40B target sits about 18-35% above the current price again, and the downside scenario's RMB 14-20B narrows to about -32% to -53%. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid still leaves the base case close to market-implied expectations, and none of the three validations — SST orders, receivable collection, cash conversion — has arrived, so the stance remains neutral watch.

upgrade.zh: 若 2026 H1/H2 报告确认 AIDC 收入继续 100%+ 增长、SST 获得 10-15 亿元级可交付订单、应收周转降至 110 天以内且经营现金流/净利超过 80%，则上调至 constructive。
upgrade.en: Move to constructive if 2026 H1/H2 reports confirm AIDC revenue still growing 100%+, SST wins RMB 1.0-1.5B of deliverable orders, receivable days fall below 110, and operating cash flow / net profit exceeds 80%.

downgrade.zh: 若 AIDC 增速跌破 100%、SST 仍无大额订单、海外工厂延迟超过 6 个月、毛利率低于 24%，或应收账款继续快于收入增长，则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to cautious if AIDC growth falls below 100%, SST still has no large orders, overseas plants slip more than 6 months, gross margin falls below 24%, or receivables keep growing faster than revenue.

title: TSMC 深度研究报告 - AI 基建链的先进制程与封装公共约束
titleEn: TSMC Deep Research Report - The Advanced-Node and Packaging Constraint in AI Infrastructure
summary: AI 基础设施书 foundry 层补位：TSMC 是整条链最硬的制造瓶颈，而不是又一个芯片设计公司。2026Q2 收入 US$40.20B（同比 +33.7%）落在指引区间上沿，毛利率 67.7% 高于 65.5-67.5% 指引；2nm 首次贡献 3% wafer revenue、7nm 及以下占 77%，HPC 占收入 66%。管理层把全年收入增速展望上调至略高于 40%，并把 2026 capex 从原 $52-56B 区间上调至 $60-64B；Q3 指引 US$44.6-45.8B。2026-07-31 重新锚定：ADR $403.31（2026-07-30 收盘）、约 $2.09T 市值、约 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales，隐含收入 CAGR 要求降至约 17%，低于未变的 20-22% 基准情景，预期差转为温和正向，立场由中性观察上调为偏多 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Foundry-layer coverage for the AI-infrastructure book: TSMC is the hard manufacturing bottleneck in the chain, not another chip designer. Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B (+33.7% YoY), at the top of guidance, with gross margin of 67.7% above the 65.5-67.5% guide; 2nm contributed 3% of wafer revenue for the first time, 7nm-and-below reached 77%, and HPC was 66% of revenue. Management lifted full-year revenue growth to slightly above 40% and raised 2026 capex from the prior $52-56B range to $60-64B, while guiding Q3 revenue to US$44.6-45.8B. Re-anchored on 2026-07-31: the ADR closed at $403.31 on 2026-07-30, about $2.09T market cap and about 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales, cutting the implied revenue CAGR requirement to roughly 17% — below the unchanged 20-22% base case. The expectation gap turns modestly positive, so the stance moves from neutral watch to constructive / medium conviction.
highlights: foundry 层补位：TSMC 是 AI 基建链的制造公共约束，用先进制程、CoWoS/3DFabric、N3/N2 和客户排产验证 AI 需求是否真的穿透到上游制造瓶颈
2026Q2 收入 US$40.20B（同比 +33.7%）、毛利率 67.7%、营业利润率 60.3%；Q3 指引 US$44.6-45.8B，全年收入增速展望上调至略高于 40%
Q2 财报显示 HPC 占收入 66%（环比 +20%），7nm 及以下先进节点占 wafer revenue 77%、2nm 首次贡献 3%；2026 capex 从原 $52-56B 区间上调至 $60-64B
2026-07-30 收盘 ADR $403.31、市值约 $2.09T、约 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales，隐含要求约 17% 收入 CAGR，低于 20-22% 基准情景；立场上调为偏多 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 2026-07-30 ADR 收盘 $403.31、约 $2.09T 市值和约 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales 计，代入本报告自身的反推公式（三年内向约 10x 正常化、要求回报 8%），隐含收入 CAGR 约 17%，低于旧锚点的约 21%。基准情景本身未变（2026 增速超 30%、2027-2028 约 20-22% CAGR、毛利率大体 60% 以上），因此由“与要求接近”转为“明显高于要求”，预期差转正。确信度保持中等：本次改善来自价格而非新的经营证据，月度收入与 Q3 确认才是进一步提升确信度的依据。
stanceRationale.en: At the $403.31 ADR close on 2026-07-30, about $2.09T market cap and about 12.8x 2026E EV/Sales, this report's own reverse-multiple formula (normalising toward about 10x over three years at an 8% required return) implies roughly 17% revenue CAGR, down from about 21% at the old anchor. The base case is unchanged (2026 growth above 30%, about 20-22% CAGR through 2028, gross margin mostly above 60%), so it moves from close to the requirement to clearly above it and the expectation gap turns positive. Conviction stays medium: the improvement is price-driven rather than evidence-driven, and monthly revenue plus Q3 confirmation are what would raise it further.

upgrade.zh: 如果月度收入、Q3 财报、N3/N2 mix 与 CoWoS 评论确认 base case 持续高于约 17% 的隐含 CAGR，同时毛利率维持 60%+ 且估值倍数没有重新扩张，则上调至 bullish。
upgrade.en: Move to bullish if monthly revenue, Q3 results, N3 / N2 mix, and CoWoS commentary confirm the base case is holding above the roughly 17% implied CAGR while gross margin remains above 60% and the valuation multiple does not re-expand.

downgrade.zh: 如果月度收入或 Q3 财报低于全年轨迹，或先进节点/封装紧张度缓解，则下调至 neutral-watch；如果海外 fab / N2 成本把结构性毛利率路径压到 60% 以下（打破溢价本身而非只是暂停），则下调至 cautious。
downgrade.en: Move to neutral-watch if monthly revenue or Q3 results fall below the full-year trajectory or advanced-node / packaging tightness eases; move to cautious if overseas fab / N2 costs push the structural gross-margin path below 60%, which would break the premium rather than merely pause it.

title: Micron Technology 深度研究报告 - AI memory 周期的 HBM/DRAM/NAND 仪表盘
titleEn: Micron Technology Deep Research Report - HBM, DRAM, and NAND Dashboard for the AI Memory Cycle
summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：MU 于 2026-07-30 收于 $874.66，较 07-29 低点反弹 +18.4%、较原锚点 -10.3%，市值约 $987.9B；按所有者 Q1 裁定按当前价格复核，维持谨慎（中确信）——隐含可持续 EPS 约 $58-73 仍高于网格加权约 $53，负预期差收窄但仍成立。】AI 基础设施书 memory-storage 层补位：Micron 是 HBM、DDR5、数据中心 SSD 和长期供货协议共同构成的 AI 供给瓶颈仪表盘。FY2026 Q3 收入 $41.46B、毛利率约 84.6%、营业利润 $33.32B、净利润 $28.24B，Q4 指引收入 $49-51B、调整后 EPS $30-32、毛利率约 86%。HBM 产能公开报道显示已售罄至 2026，16 个战略客户协议中 14 个最低合同收入约 $100B、约 $22B 现金存款/承诺。2026-07-07 v5 更新：以 $975.56（2026-07-02 收盘，旧锚点）、市值约 $1.10T 计，20% 牛市 / 50% 基准 / 30% 熊市情景网格给出温和负偏斜，判断改为谨慎 / 中确信。2026-07-09 官方公告最多 $3B 的美国供应链投入、拟向 GlobalWafers 融资 $500M 并签 10 年 300mm 原始硅片协议，强化长期供给响应证据，但不代表新增 bit supply 已上线，也不刷新 2026-07-02 估值快照。
summaryEn: [2026-07-31 stance re-adjudication: MU closed at $874.66 on 2026-07-30, +18.4% off the 07-29 low and -10.3% from its old anchor, for about $987.9B market cap; re-checked at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling, cautious (medium conviction) holds — implied sustainable EPS of ~$58-73 still exceeds the grid-weighted ~$53, a narrowed but intact negative gap.] Memory-storage coverage for the AI-infrastructure book: Micron is the dashboard for HBM, DDR5, data-center SSDs, and long-term supply agreements as AI supply constraints move into memory. FY2026 Q3 revenue was $41.46B, gross margin about 84.6%, operating income $33.32B, and net income $28.24B; Q4 guidance is $49-51B revenue, $30-32 adjusted EPS, and about 86% gross margin. Public reports say HBM capacity is sold out through 2026, and 14 of 16 strategic customer agreements have about $100B of minimum contract revenue plus roughly $22B deposits / commitments. July 7, 2026 v5 update: at $975.56 (Jul 2, 2026 close, old anchor) and about $1.10T market cap, a 20% bull / 50% base / 30% bear grid moves the stance to cautious / medium conviction. Micron's official 2026-07-09 release adds up to $3B of U.S. supply-chain investment, proposed $500M GlobalWafers financing, and a 10-year 300mm raw-wafer agreement; this strengthens long-term supply-response evidence without putting new bit supply online or refreshing the 2026-07-02 valuation snapshot.
highlights: memory-storage 层补位：MU 用 HBM sold-out、DRAM/NAND 价格、数据中心 SSD 和 SCA 长期协议校验 AI 需求是否穿透到 memory bit/带宽/价格
16 个 SCA 中 14 个最低合同收入约 $100B，约 $22B 存款/承诺；公开报道显示 HBM 产能售罄至 2026，且只能满足约 50%-66% 客户需求
按 $874.66（2026-07-30 收盘）：市值约 $987.9B、TTM P/E 约 19.7x（Q4 年化 run-rate 约 7.1x）；隐含可持续 EPS 约 $58-73 仍高于我们约 $53 的加权值，负偏斜收窄但未消失——维持谨慎 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 2026-07-31 按所有者 Q1 裁定以当前价格复核。按 2026-07-30 收盘 $874.66（市值约 $987.9B、EV 约 $968.3B），TTM P/E 约 19.7x、Q4 年化 run-rate P/E 约 7.1x；12-15x 通周期框架隐含可持续 EPS 约 $58-73，仍高于网格加权的约 $53——"内存均值回归风险未被完全定价"的谨慎前提收窄但在当前价格下仍成立，维持谨慎/中确信，下一验证点 2026-09-23。
stanceRationale.en: Re-checked 2026-07-31 at the current price under the owner's Q1 ruling. At the 2026-07-30 close of $874.66 (about $987.9B cap, $968.3B EV), TTM P/E is about 19.7x and the Q4-annualized run-rate P/E about 7.1x; the 12-15x through-cycle frame implies about $58-73 of sustainable EPS, still above the grid-weighted ~$53 — the cautious premise (memory mean-reversion risk not fully priced) is narrower than at the old anchor but still true at the current price, so cautious / medium conviction holds; next test 2026-09-23.

benchmarkRationale.zh: power 层默认基准是 XLU（公用事业）。Quanta 不是公用事业公司——它没有费率基数、没有受监管回报，它的经济由在手订单、技术工人和施工利润率决定，用 XLU 计分等于在问『一家承包商有没有跑赢受监管公用事业』，与本报告的任何一句判断都不相干。实测的差距是决定性的：截至 2026-07-31，PWR 与 XLU 的日收益率相关系数在最近 252 个交易日仅 0.279、504 个交易日 0.337，而与 PAVE（Global X 美国基础设施建设 ETF）分别为 0.635 与 0.654，与 XLI 为 0.598 与 0.603；PAVE 在两个窗口上都优于 XLI，且主题上更贴近『把基础设施建起来的那批公司』。本报告的核心论点正是关于建设与并网这道工序，检验它需要一个自带施工景气 beta 的基准。代价必须写明，而且有两条：其一，PWR 本身就是 PAVE 的前三大持仓（第三方持仓数据给出的权重在 3.7-4.2% 之间且彼此不一致），因此 PWR 自身的波动会带动基准、压缩测得的超额收益；其二，2026 年初至今 PWR +56.0% 而 PAVE 仅 +17.6%，说明基准对今年这轮行情几乎没有解释力，0.635 的相关性仍留下约六成方差无法解释——PAVE 还混入了铁路、骨料、钢铁与机械，跑赢 PAVE 并不能单独证明电网 EPC 的论点。即便如此，与一个相关性只有 0.28 的公用事业指数相比，这仍是明显更诚实的计分尺。PAVE 不是本报告的 priceSymbol，未触发自基准禁令。
benchmarkRationale.en: The power layer default is XLU (utilities). Quanta is not a utility - it has no rate base and no regulated return, and its economics are backlog, craft labour and construction margin - so scoring against XLU asks 'did a contractor beat regulated utilities', which bears on no judgment in this report. The measured gap is decisive: to 2026-07-31, PWR's daily-return correlation is only 0.279 over the trailing 252 sessions and 0.337 over 504 against XLU, versus 0.635 and 0.654 against PAVE (the Global X U.S. Infrastructure Development ETF) and 0.598 and 0.603 against XLI. PAVE beats XLI on both windows and is the closer thematic match to 'the companies that physically build infrastructure'. This report's core claim is precisely about the build-and-connect step, and testing it requires a benchmark that carries construction-cycle beta. The cost is stated plainly, and it has two parts. First, PWR is itself a top-three PAVE holding (third-party holdings aggregators put the weight somewhere between 3.7% and 4.2% and disagree with each other), so part of any PWR move is transmitted into the benchmark and mutes measured alpha. Second, PWR is +56.0% year-to-date in 2026 against PAVE's +17.6%, so the benchmark explains almost none of this year's move, and a 0.635 correlation still leaves roughly 60% of variance unexplained - PAVE also bundles rails, aggregates, steel and machinery, so beating PAVE does not by itself validate the grid-EPC thesis. Even so, it is a markedly more honest yardstick than a utilities index correlated 0.28. PAVE is not this report's own priceSymbol, so the self-benchmark ban is not engaged.

title: Quanta Services 深度研究报告 - 建设与并网这一层是否卡住了 AI 数据中心通电
titleEn: Quanta Services Deep Research Report - Does the Build-and-Connect Layer Gate AI Data-Center Power?
summary: AI 基础设施书 power 层的公共约束初始覆盖：该层已有八篇报告，全部关于谁拥有电子或谁造设备，没有一篇覆盖真正把线路架起来、把变电站装好、把场地通上电的那一层。本报告提供这份读数，答案有一部分是否定的：按 2026 年披露，施工劳动力并不是绑定约束——Quanta 在收入同比 +41.2%（2026 Q2 95.57 亿美元）的同时把电力分部营业利润率从 10.1% 提到 11.5%，并在五个月内把全年收入指引从 332.5-337.5 亿美元上调到 393-397 亿美元（+17.9%，其中约 47 亿美元为内生）。绑定约束不长这样。真正指向瓶颈的是 Quanta 自己的资本配置：同一季度以 12.4 亿美元买下 Percheron（路权与许可）、Enerfab（制造加工）、PSD（可移动式变电站）与 Phalcon（数据中心电气），另设 800 kV 断路器合资公司——钱流向前端与长交期硬件。同样重要的是一个否定结论：Quanta 自 2025 Q1 起只报两个分部（可再生能源已并入电力）、不披露数据中心收入、且大量数据中心工作接单即开票从不进入在手订单，因此本书无法把 PWR 当作 AI 需求温度计。公司层面：总在手订单 534.4 亿美元（+49.1%）、12 个月 323.1 亿美元（+61.2%），且增长的是硬的那部分——剩余履约义务 +75.1%，占比由 53.5% 升至 62.8%；上半年自由现金流 10.704 亿美元高于 GAAP 净利润 6.720 亿美元；商誉加无形资产 110.850 亿美元超过股东权益 96.379 亿美元。以 2026-07-30 收盘 657.98 美元为锚（业绩后单日 +17.3%、年初至今 +56.0%），市值约 989 亿美元，按截至 2026-06-30 追溯十二个月约 74.6x 报告盈利、48.5x 调整后净利润、30.2x 企业价值/调整后 EBITDA；按 2026 年指引 39.4x 调整后每股收益、56.4x GAAP 每股收益，而同行只有 15.7-24.7x。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial common-constraint coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's power layer. The layer already holds eight reports and every one is about who owns electrons or who makes equipment; none covers the tier that physically builds the line, sets the substation and energises the site. This report supplies that reading, and part of the answer is negative: on 2026 disclosure, construction labour is not the binding constraint. Quanta grew revenue 41.2% year over year (Q2 2026 revenue of US$9.56B) while expanding Electric-segment operating margin from 10.1% to 11.5%, and raised its full-year revenue guide from US$33.25-33.75B to US$39.3-39.7B in five months (+17.9%, of which roughly US$4.7B is organic). A binding constraint does not behave that way. What does point at a bottleneck is Quanta's own capital allocation: US$1.24B in one quarter for Percheron (right-of-way and permitting), Enerfab (fabrication), PSD (transportable substations) and Phalcon (data-centre electrical), plus an 800 kV circuit-breaker joint venture - the money is going to the front end and to long-lead hardware. A second, equally important finding is negative: Quanta has reported only two segments since Q1 2025 (Renewable Energy was folded into Electric), discloses no data-centre revenue, and books and bills much data-centre work without it ever entering backlog, so this book cannot use PWR as an AI-demand thermometer. At the company level, total backlog is US$53.44B (+49.1%) and 12-month backlog US$32.31B (+61.2%), and the firm component is what grew - remaining performance obligations +75.1%, rising from 53.5% to 62.8% of backlog; H1 free cash flow of US$1,070.4M exceeds GAAP net income of US$672.0M; goodwill plus intangibles of US$11,085.0M exceed equity of US$9,637.9M. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of US$657.98 (+17.3% on the day of the print, +56.0% year-to-date), market cap is about US$98.9B at roughly 74.6x trailing reported earnings, 48.5x trailing adjusted net income and 30.2x EV/trailing adjusted EBITDA on the twelve months ended 2026-06-30, and 39.4x guided 2026 adjusted EPS against 56.4x guided GAAP EPS, versus listed peers at 15.7-24.7x. A 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid opens the initiation at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: 并网约束检验的答案是否定的：施工劳动力不卡 AI 数据中心通电——收入 +41.2% 的同时电力分部利润率从 10.1% 升到 11.5%，全年收入指引五个月内上调 17.9%
Quanta 自己的资本配置指向前端：单季 12.4 亿美元买路权与许可（Percheron）、制造加工（Enerfab）、可移动式变电站（PSD）与数据中心电气（Phalcon），另建 800 kV 断路器合资厂
本书不能把 PWR 当 AI 温度计：自 2025 Q1 只报两个分部（可再生能源已并入电力）、无数据中心收入披露、大量数据中心工作接单即开票不进在手订单
在手订单变硬而非变软：总额 534.4 亿美元（+49.1%）、12 个月 323.1 亿美元（+61.2%），剩余履约义务 +75.1% 且占比由 53.5% 升至 62.8%
股价 657.98 美元（2026-07-30 收盘、业绩后单日 +17.3%）：追溯十二个月约 74.6x 报告盈利 / 48.5x 调整后净利润 / 30.2x 企业价值-调整后 EBITDA，2026 年指引 39.4x 调整后 EPS vs 56.4x GAAP EPS，同行 15.7-24.7x；30/40/30 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

latest.en: At 2026-06-30 total backlog was US$53.44B (+49.1% y/y) and 12-month backlog US$32.31B (+61.2%). Within that, remaining performance obligations of US$33.55B grew 75.1% while estimated MSA and short-term orders of US$19.89B grew 19.2%, lifting the firm share of backlog from 53.5% a year earlier to 62.8%. Graded within: this item's published trigger is RPO growing more slowly than MSA estimates, or the RPO share falling toward 55% - neither happened, and the firm component grew nearly four times as fast as the soft one.

latest.zh: 2026 Q2 电力分部收入 78.378 亿美元（同比 +43.6%）、营业利润率 11.5%（去年同期 10.1%）；上半年 143.065 亿美元、10.2%（去年 9.2%）。地下与基础设施同期由 6.9% 升至 9.1%，全年收入指引同时被上调 17.9%。　评级为阈内：本项发布的触发条件是利润率压缩至 10% 以下且增速放缓，或管理层指引受劳动力限制——实际是利润率扩张、增速加快、指引上调，三者都与触发条件相反。需注意管理层关于四年学徒周期的说法意味着 2030 年产能由今天的招聘决定，因此本项近端为阈内并不排除远端绑定。
latest.en: Q2 2026 Electric revenue was US$7,837.8M (+43.6% y/y) at an 11.5% operating margin against 10.1% a year earlier; H1 revenue was US$14,306.5M at 10.2% against 9.2%. Underground and Infrastructure moved from 6.9% to 9.1% over the same comparison, and the full-year revenue guide was raised 17.9%. Graded within: this item's published trigger is margin compressing below 10% alongside decelerating growth, or management guiding to labour-constrained delivery - what happened is margin expansion, faster growth and a raised guide, the opposite of all three. Note that management's own roughly four-year apprenticeship framing means 2030 capacity is set by today's hiring, so a near-term within reading does not rule out a later binding constraint.

trigger.zh: Quanta 开始把科技/负荷中心收入或在手订单单列，或披露单一客户占收入 10% 以上；在此之前，本书对 PWR 的任何 AI 归因都无法证伪
trigger.en: Quanta begins disclosing technology or load-centre revenue or backlog as a separate line, or discloses a customer above 10% of revenue; absent that, any AI attribution to PWR in this book stays unfalsifiable

latest.zh: 截至 2026 Q2：Quanta 自 2025 Q1 起只报两个分部（电力、地下与基础设施），可再生能源基础设施解决方案分部已并入电力且历史期间重述；无数据中心或科技终端市场收入披露；无 10% 以上客户披露；管理层并表示大量数据中心工作接单即开票、从不进入在手订单。　评级为读数不明而非阈内或已触发：本项的触发条件是某项披露出现，而该披露没有出现——这既不能确认也不能否定 AI 归因，而记录这个状态正是本项的意义。
latest.en: As of Q2 2026, Quanta reports two segments (Electric, and Underground and Infrastructure); the Renewable Energy Infrastructure Solutions segment was folded into Electric from Q1 2025 with prior periods recast; there is no data-centre or technology end-market revenue disclosure and no customer disclosed above 10%; and management states that much data-centre work is booked and billed without entering backlog. Graded unclear rather than within or breached: this item's trigger is the appearance of a disclosure, and that disclosure has not appeared - which neither confirms nor refutes an AI attribution, and recording that state is the point of the item.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 年 Form 10-K 的分部与客户集中度披露（2027 年 2 月）/ segment and customer-concentration disclosure in the FY2026 Form 10-K, February 2027

metric.zh: 自由现金流对 GAAP 净利润，以及商誉加无形资产对股东权益
metric.en: Free cash flow against GAAP net income, and goodwill plus intangibles against equity

trigger.zh: 自由现金流连续两个半年度低于 GAAP 净利润，或商誉加无形资产超出股东权益 30% 以上
trigger.en: free cash flow falls below GAAP net income for two consecutive half-years, or goodwill plus intangibles exceed equity by more than 30%

latest.zh: 2026 上半年：经营现金流 14.872 亿美元、净资本开支 4.168 亿美元、自由现金流 10.704 亿美元，高于同期 GAAP 净利润 6.720 亿美元；2026-06-30 商誉 78.689 亿加其他无形资产 32.161 亿 = 110.850 亿美元，为股东权益 96.379 亿美元的约 115%（即超出 15%）。　评级为阈内：两条触发条件——连续两个半年度现金流低于净利润、无形资产超出权益 30% 以上——都未达到。但超出 15% 已意味着有形账面权益为负约 14.5 亿美元，距第二条触发线并不遥远。
latest.en: For H1 2026, operating cash flow was US$1,487.2M and net capital expenditures US$416.8M, giving free cash flow of US$1,070.4M against GAAP net income of US$672.0M. At 2026-06-30, goodwill of US$7,868.9M plus other intangibles of US$3,216.1M totalled US$11,085.0M, about 115% of the US$9,637.9M of stockholders' equity - an excess of 15%. Graded within: neither published clause is met - free cash flow exceeds net income rather than trailing it, and the intangible excess is 15% rather than above 30%. But the 15% excess already means tangible book equity is roughly negative US$1.45B, so the second clause is not far away.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 Q3 现金流量表与资产负债表（2026 年 10 月下旬）/ the Q3 2026 cash-flow statement and balance sheet, late October 2026

metric.zh: 2027 年指引相对 2030 年调整后每股收益目标的持久性
metric.en: Guidance durability: FY2027 guidance against the 2030 adjusted-EPS target

trigger.zh: 2027 年初始指引隐含的调整后每股收益增速低于十几个百分点的中段，或 2030 年目标未被重申
trigger.en: initial FY2027 guidance implies adjusted-EPS growth below the mid-teens, or the 2030 target is not reaffirmed

latest.zh: 2026 年调整后每股收益指引中值 16.70 美元，较 2025 年实际 10.75 美元 +55.3%；投资者日报道的 2030 年目标为 21.60-26.75 美元（第三方报道，该活动未报送 Form 8-K），据此从 2026 年指引起算的隐含年复合增速仅 6.6%-12.5%，低于目标搭建时所依据的 15-20%。　本项暂不评级：2027 年初始指引要到 2027 年 2 月才发布，触发条件的两条都还不可观察，初始覆盖也没有可比对象。
latest.en: The FY2026 adjusted-EPS guide midpoint of US$16.70 is +55.3% over the FY2025 actual of US$10.75. The Investor Day 2030 target reported by third parties is US$21.60-26.75 (no Form 8-K was furnished for the event), which from the 2026 guide implies a CAGR of only 6.6-12.5%, below the 15-20% the target was built on. Left ungraded: initial FY2027 guidance is not due until February 2027, so neither clause of the trigger is observable yet and an initiation has nothing to compare against.

monitoring.nextCheck: 2026 全年业绩与 2027 财年初始指引（2027 年 2 月）/ FY2026 results and initial FY2027 guidance, February 2027

stanceRationale.zh: 以 657.98 美元（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市场已经把这次业绩完整定价进去——单日 +17.3%、年初至今 +56.0%。经营证据是全书里最强的一档：总在手订单 534.4 亿美元且增长的是硬的那部分（剩余履约义务 +75.1%、占比 53.5% → 62.8%），电力与地下两个分部利润率同时扩张，上半年自由现金流 10.704 亿美元高于 GAAP 净利润 6.720 亿美元，杠杆 1.6x 且穆迪上调至 Baa2。因此『谨慎』是不诚实的——这里没有下行尾部。但倍数也不允许偏多：约 74.6x 追溯报告盈利、48.5x 追溯调整后净利润、30.2x 企业价值/追溯调整后 EBITDA；2026 年指引 39.4x 调整后每股收益，而同一份指引的 GAAP 口径是 56.4x，两者 43.2% 的差额正是制造增长的那些并购所产生的摊销与股权激励；做重叠业务的上市同行只有 15.7-24.7x 前瞻。30/40/30 网格在概率上对称、在幅度上刻意不对称，这本身就是结论：下行分支不是经营塌陷，而是在业务完好前提下倍数向同行压缩，仅此一项算术上约 −40%；上行分支要求盈利长进一个已经是全板块最高的倍数里。确信度定为中而非高，是因为本报告为本书而存在的那个 AI 归因问题，从 Quanta 的备案文件中根本无法回答——两个分部、无数据中心收入行、大量工作不进在手订单。
stanceRationale.en: At US$657.98 (2026-07-30 close) the market has already priced the print in full - up 17.3% on the day and 56.0% year-to-date. The operating evidence is among the strongest in this book: total backlog of US$53.44B in which the firm component is what grew (remaining performance obligations +75.1%, rising from 53.5% to 62.8% of backlog), margin expansion in both segments, H1 free cash flow of US$1,070.4M against GAAP net income of US$672.0M, leverage at 1.6x and a Moody's upgrade to Baa2. Cautious would therefore be dishonest - there is no downside tail here. But the multiple does not permit constructive either: about 74.6x trailing reported earnings, 48.5x trailing adjusted net income and 30.2x EV to trailing adjusted EBITDA, and 39.4x guided 2026 adjusted EPS against 56.4x the GAAP version of the same guidance - a 43.2% gap that is precisely the amortisation and stock compensation created by the acquisitions that manufacture the growth - while listed peers doing overlapping work sit at 15.7-24.7x forward. The 30/40/30 grid is symmetric in probability and deliberately asymmetric in magnitude, and that is the finding: the bear branch is not an operating collapse but a multiple compression toward peers on an intact business, worth roughly -40% arithmetically, while the bull branch requires earnings to grow into the highest multiple in the sector. Conviction is medium rather than high because the AI-attribution question this report exists to answer for the book is simply unanswerable from Quanta's filings - two segments, no data-centre revenue line, and much of the work never entering backlog.

upgrade.zh: 2027 年初始指引隐含调整后每股收益继续 20%+ 增长且电力分部营业利润率守在 11% 以上，创纪录的剩余履约义务在没有重大项目减值的情况下转化，剩余履约义务占总在手订单比重守在 60% 以上，且进一步指引上调中内生部分仍占多数，则上调至偏多。
upgrade.en: Upgrade to constructive if initial FY2027 guidance implies continued 20%+ adjusted-EPS growth with the Electric segment holding an 11%+ operating margin, the record remaining performance obligations convert without a material project charge, the RPO share of total backlog holds above 60%, and the organic component remains the majority of any further guidance raise.

downgrade.zh: 电力分部出现重大项目减值或利润率回吐、2027 年指引隐含调整后每股收益增速低于十几个百分点的中段、硬性剩余履约义务占在手订单比重回落至约 55%、并购成为某次指引上调的主要来源，或自由现金流连续两个半年度低于 GAAP 净利润而商誉与无形资产相对股东权益继续上升，则下调至谨慎。
downgrade.en: Downgrade to cautious on a material project charge or margin reversal in the Electric segment, FY2027 guidance implying sub-mid-teens adjusted-EPS growth, the firm RPO share of backlog falling back toward 55%, acquisitions becoming the majority of a guidance raise, or free cash flow falling below GAAP net income for two consecutive half-years while goodwill and intangibles keep rising against equity.

title: Alphabet 深度研究报告 - TPU 外部化与 capex 融资质量的架构校验
titleEn: Alphabet Deep Research Report - Architecture Check on TPU Externalization and Capex Funding Quality
summary: AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的架构校验初始覆盖：本层已有两篇公共约束（Microsoft、Meta）和一篇仪表盘（Oracle），Alphabet 承担只有它能做的买方架构检验——全球最大自研芯片项目开始向第三方出售 TPU 系统，使它同时是商用芯片的前二大客户和竞争者。2026 Q2（季度截至 2026-06-30、07-22 发布）：收入 $119.796B（+24%）、Google Cloud +82% 至 $24.768B 且分部利润率 20.7%→35.6%、Search 及其他 +17%、合并经营利润率 34.0%、收入积压 $519.5B（Cloud $513.9B）。10-Q 首次写明 Cloud 产品收入主要来自 TPU 系统销售，存货半年由 $2.439B 升至 $9.991B。但同一季度自由现金流为 −$5.855B、回购连续两季为 $0（$69.5B 授权未动用）、6 月增发股权净额 $49.6B、股本 12,088M→12,230M，FY2026 capex 指引上调至 $195-205B、2027 年将显著更高。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $333.68 为锚（财报次日 07-23 单日 −6.9%），市值约 $4.081T、约 9.2x TTM 收入、约 26.7x EV/TTM 经营利润、约 73.9x EV/TTM 自由现金流；追溯 GAAP 市盈率约 16.7x 不可用，因 Q2 每股 $9.11 中 $6.26 来自权益证券估值变动，清洗后至少约 29.7x。30% 牛市 / 50% 基准 / 20% 熊市网格读出轻度正偏度但建立在预测之上，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial architecture-check coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer. The layer already carries two common-constraint reports (Microsoft, Meta) and one dashboard (Oracle); Alphabet takes the buyer-side architecture test only it can run - the largest own-silicon program in the world has begun selling TPU systems to third parties, making it simultaneously a top-two merchant-silicon customer and a merchant-silicon competitor. Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported 07-22): revenue $119.796B (+24%), Google Cloud +82% to $24.768B with segment margin going from 20.7% to 35.6%, Search and other +17%, consolidated operating margin 34.0%, revenue backlog $519.5B (Google Cloud $513.9B). The 10-Q states for the first time that Cloud product revenue comes primarily from TPU system sales, and inventory rose from $2.439B to $9.991B in six months. The same quarter produced free cash flow of -$5.855B, a second straight quarter of $0 buybacks (with $69.5B of authorization unused), a $49.6B net equity raise in June, share count rising from 12,088M to 12,230M, and an FY2026 capex guide raised to $195-205B with 2027 to be significantly higher. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of $333.68 (the stock fell 6.9% on 07-23, the session after the print), market cap is ~$4.081T at ~9.2x TTM revenue, ~26.7x EV/TTM operating income and ~73.9x EV/TTM free cash flow; the ~16.7x trailing GAAP P/E is unusable because $6.26 of Q2's $9.11 EPS came from equity-securities marks, leaving at least ~29.7x on cleaned earnings. The 30% bull / 50% base / 20% bear grid shows a mild positive skew that rests on forecasts, so the initiation opens at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: demand-risk 层架构校验：TPU 外部化对阵商用芯片，与供给侧 broadcom-2026 配对形成双向检验
TPU 成为财务对象：10-Q 写明 Cloud 产品收入主要来自 TPU 系统销售，存货半年 $2.439B→$9.991B，现有协议绝大部分收入指引在 2027 年
融资结构反转：Q2 自由现金流 −$5.855B、上半年回购 $0（$69.5B 授权未动用）、6 月增发净额 $49.6B、股本 12,088M→12,230M
股价 $333.68（2026-07-30 收盘、财报次日 −6.9%）：约 9.2x TTM 收入、约 73.9x EV/TTM 自由现金流；30/50/20 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

metric.zh: 广告技术救济与 Search 上诉结果
metric.en: Ad-tech remedy and Search appeal outcome

trigger.zh: 弗吉尼亚东区判决结构性救济（剥离发布方广告技术）并在上诉后维持，或哥伦比亚特区巡回法院扩大 2025 年 12 月的 Search 救济范围
trigger.en: The Eastern District of Virginia orders a structural remedy (divestiture of publisher-side ad tech) that survives appeal, or the D.C. Circuit expands the December 2025 Search remedies

latest.zh: 广告技术案自 2025 年 11 月结案陈词后终审判决仍未作出，DOJ 的方案包含 10-Q 自述可能对业务产生重大不利影响的结构性救济；Search 案 2025 年 12 月终审为行为性救济，Google 于 2026 年 1 月上诉、DOJ 与各州于 2026 年 2 月上诉，口头辩论预计 2026 年底至 2027 年初；直接被指向的 Google Network 为 2026 Q2 收入的 6% 且在收缩；短期计提法律与监管罚款及和解 $17.4B
latest.en: The ad-tech case has been awaiting final judgment since November 2025 closing arguments, with the DOJ proposing structural remedies that the 10-Q itself says could have a material adverse effect on the business; the Search case ended in behavioural remedies in December 2025, Google appealed in January 2026 and the DOJ and state AGs in February 2026, with argument expected late 2026 or early 2027; Google Network, the most directly implicated line, was 6% of Q2 2026 revenue and shrinking; short-term accrued legal and regulatory fines and settlements were $17.4B

monitoring.nextCheck: 弗吉尼亚东区终审判决与哥伦比亚特区巡回法院口头辩论（事件驱动）/ EDVA final judgment and D.C. Circuit argument (event-driven)

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $333.68（2026-07-30 收盘）计，市场在财报次日把 Alphabet 下调了 6.9%，股价较 5 月 13 日 $398.80 的收盘高点低约 16.3%——与 Microsoft 同期 +15.5% 的跳涨恰好相反。但折价本身不等于机会：约 9.2x TTM 收入、约 26.7x EV/TTM 经营利润、约 73.9x EV/TTM 自由现金流、以及清洗后至少约 29.7x 追溯盈利，仍假设自由现金流低谷是浅而暂时的。30% 牛市 / 50% 基准 / 20% 熊市网格的算术偏度轻度正向，但正向的一侧依赖 2027 年尚不可验证的事件（TPU 收入确认、自由现金流转正），负向的一侧已经印在 2026 上半年的现金流量表上（自由现金流转负、回购归零、增发 $49.6B、股本上升），因此以中性观察而非偏多开局。
stanceRationale.en: At $333.68 (2026-07-30 close) the market marked Alphabet down 6.9% on the session after the print, leaving it ~16.3% below the 2026-05-13 closing high of $398.80 - the mirror image of Microsoft's +15.5% pop over the same weeks. The de-rating is not by itself an opportunity: ~9.2x TTM revenue, ~26.7x EV/TTM operating income, ~73.9x EV/TTM free cash flow, and at least ~29.7x cleaned trailing earnings still assume the free-cash-flow trough is shallow and temporary. The 30% bull / 50% base / 20% bear grid carries a mild positive arithmetic skew, but the positive side depends on 2027 events nobody can yet verify (TPU revenue recognition, FCF turning positive) while the negative side is already printed on the H1 2026 cash-flow statement (FCF negative, buybacks at zero, $49.6B of equity issued, share count rising) - so the initiation opens at neutral-watch rather than constructive.

upgrade.zh: 季度自由现金流在 2027 年转正且 TTM 自由现金流重新扩张、Cloud 维持 50% 以上增长且 backlog 按期转化、TPU 外部收入按指引在 2027 年确认并在 Cloud 产品收入中变得可见、回购恢复且无进一步股权发行、且合并经营利润率在折旧爬坡时保持 32% 以上，则上调至偏多。
upgrade.en: Quarterly free cash flow turns positive during 2027 with TTM FCF re-expanding, Cloud holds above 50% growth with backlog converting on schedule, external TPU revenue recognizes in 2027 as guided and becomes visible in Cloud product revenue, buybacks resume without further equity issuance, and consolidated operating margin stays above 32% as depreciation ramps - upgrade to constructive.

downgrade.zh: TTM 自由现金流转负、或 Alphabet 动用 $40B ATM 计划或进一步增发股权、Cloud 增速跌破约 40% 且 backlog 转化滑期、合并经营利润率随折旧浪潮落地跌破约 30%、TPU 外部收入滑出 2027 年、或结构性广告技术救济被判决，则下调至谨慎。
downgrade.en: TTM free cash flow turns negative, or Alphabet draws the $40B ATM or issues further equity, Cloud growth decelerates below ~40% while backlog conversion slips, consolidated operating margin falls below ~30% as the depreciation wave lands, external TPU revenue slips out of 2027, or a structural ad-tech remedy is ordered - downgrade to cautious.

title: Microsoft 深度研究报告 - Azure AI 收入与 capex 吸收的需求锚
titleEn: Microsoft Deep Research Report - Demand Anchor for Azure AI Revenue vs Capex Absorption
summary: AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的需求锚初始覆盖：Microsoft 是全球最大 AI capex 买方，本书此前给 GPU/HBM/电力稀缺性打分却没有覆盖这些开支落地的资产负债表。FY2026 Q4（季度截至 2026-06-30，07-29 发布）：收入 $90.007B（+18%）、Azure 及其他云 +43% 加速、FY2026 Azure 收入首破 $100B（+41%）、商业 RPO $678B（+84%）、Q4 含融资租赁 capex $41B（+69%）、FY2026 经营现金流 $182.9B、现金 capex $115.9B、FCF 约 $67B——demand 层最强的 capex 吸收答卷。风险同样清晰：2026 年 1 月披露的 $625B RPO 中约 45% 系于 OpenAI；FY2027 Q1 capex 指引超 $50B；数据中心/办公楼寿命 15→25 年重分类把日历 2026 capex 框架由约 $190B 改列约 $175B。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $451.10 为锚（财报后单日 +15.5%），市值约 $3.35T、约 25.1x 追溯 GAAP EPS、约 10.1x FY2026 收入、约 49x EV/FY2026 FCF。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格读出略偏负到中性的预期差，初始立场中性观察 / 中确信。
summaryEn: Initial demand-anchor coverage for the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer: Microsoft is the largest AI-capex buyer in the world, and until now the book scored GPU/HBM/power scarcity without covering the balance sheet that spending lands on. FY2026 Q4 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported 07-29): revenue $90.007B (+18%), Azure and other cloud +43% and accelerating, FY2026 Azure revenue above $100B for the first time (+41%), commercial RPO $678B (+84%), Q4 capex incl. finance leases $41B (+69%), FY2026 operating cash flow $182.9B against $115.9B cash capex leaving ~$67B FCF - the strongest capex-absorption print in the demand layer. The risks are equally clear: ~45% of the $625B RPO disclosed in January 2026 was tied to OpenAI; FY2027 Q1 capex is guided above $50B; and the 15-to-25-year useful-life reclassification moved the calendar-2026 capex frame from ~$190B to ~$175B. Anchored to the 2026-07-30 close of $451.10 (+15.5% on the post-earnings session), market cap is ~$3.35T at ~25.1x trailing GAAP EPS, ~10.1x FY2026 revenue, and ~49x EV/FY2026 FCF. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid reads a slightly negative-to-neutral expectation gap; the initiation opens at neutral-watch / medium conviction.
highlights: demand-risk 层需求锚：全球最大 AI capex 买方首次入册；核心读数是 Azure AI 收入 vs capex 吸收
FY2026 Q4 收入 $90.007B（+18%）、Azure +43% 加速、FY2026 Azure 收入首破 $100B、商业 RPO $678B（+84%）

风险集中：1 月披露 $625B RPO 中约 45% 系于 OpenAI；FY2027 Q1 capex 指引超 $50B；寿命 15→25 年重分类美化后续折旧口径
股价 $451.10（2026-07-30 收盘、财报后单日 +15.5%）：约 25.1x 追溯 GAAP、约 49x EV/FY2026 FCF；30/40/30 网格，初始中性观察 / 中确信

stanceRationale.zh: 以 $451.10（2026-07-30 收盘，财报后单日 +15.5%）计，市场重新拥抱了 6 月才抛弃的吸收论：约 26x 非 GAAP 追溯盈利与约 49x EV/FY2026 FCF 假设 Azure 40%+ 延续、OpenAI 不出事故、FCF 在建设正常化后修复。30% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 30% 熊市网格认为经营证据是 demand 层最强的，但入场价已经把它的延续计入，预期差略偏负到中性。
stanceRationale.en: At $451.10 (2026-07-30 close, +15.5% on the post-earnings session), the market has re-embraced the absorption thesis it abandoned in June: ~26x non-GAAP trailing earnings and ~49x EV/FY2026 FCF assume Azure sustains 40%+, no OpenAI accident, and FCF repair once the build normalizes. The 30% bull / 40% base / 30% bear grid sees the operating evidence as the strongest in the demand layer, but the entry price already capitalizes its continuation, leaving a slightly negative-to-neutral expectation gap.

title: Meta Platforms 深度研究报告 - AI 基建书的需求锚与算力外售压力测试

summary: 2026-07-30 监测更新（Q2 2026，季度截至 2026-06-30）：收入 $60.80B（同比 +28%）、营业利润 $18.775B、营业利润率 31%（去年同期 43%）、净利润 $15.848B（同比 -14%）、摊薄 EPS $6.18；总成本费用 $42.026B（同比 +55%）。经营现金流 $31.862B（+25%），但 $31.078B capex 把自由现金流压至 $0.784B（-91%）；FY2026 capex 指引收窄至 $130-145B。application-monetization 是混合读数：收入与经营现金流增长，营业利润率、净利润与 FCF 恶化。本中心 AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的需求锚覆盖：Meta 不是 GPU/HBM/电力/光模块供应商，而是整条链最重要的终端买方之一。2026-07-31 重新锚定至 2026-07-30 收盘 $539.03：市值约 $1.37T、EV 约 $1.41T，约 6.4x TTM P/S、约 15.9x EV/TTM 营业利润，按 Q1 剔除税益 EPS 年化约 18.4x（按 Q2 实际 EPS 年化约 21.8x）。倍数较旧锚点更宽松，立场按当前价格算术维持 neutral-watch / 中确信；上述 TTM 口径为 Q2'25-Q1'26，不含 2026 Q2，Q2 的 FCF 与利润率恶化关系到偏斜，须由 Q2 后重建口径的重新承保处理。

季度 capex $31.078B 把自由现金流压至 $0.784B（-91%）；FY2026 capex 指引 $130-145B，下限自 $125B 上调，2027 回落路径未见

summaryEn: July 30, 2026 monitoring update (Q2 2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026): revenue was $60.80B (+28% YoY), operating income $18.775B, operating margin 31% (down from 43%), net income $15.848B (-14%), and diluted EPS $6.18; total costs were $42.026B (+55%). Operating cash flow was $31.862B (+25%), but $31.078B of capex compressed free cash flow to $0.784B (-91%); FY2026 capex guidance narrowed to $130-145B. Application-monetization is a mixed read: revenue and operating cash flow grew, while operating margin, net income, and FCF deteriorated. Demand-anchor coverage for this center's AI-infrastructure demand-risk layer: Meta is not a GPU/HBM/power/optical supplier, but one of the most important end customers in the chain. Re-anchored on 2026-07-31 to the $539.03 close of 2026-07-30: market cap is about $1.37T and EV about $1.41T, or about 6.4x TTM sales, 15.9x EV/TTM operating income, and 18.4x annualized Q1 EPS ex-tax-benefit (21.8x on annualized Q2 reported EPS). The multiple is less demanding than at the old anchor, so the stance is held at neutral-watch / medium conviction on current-price arithmetic; note the TTM window is Q2'25-Q1'26 and excludes Q2 2026, whose FCF and margin deterioration bears on the skew and is carried to a post-Q2 re-underwrite.

title: Oracle 深度研究报告 - AI 云 RPO 仪表盘与资本开支融资压力
titleEn: Oracle Deep Research Report - AI Cloud RPO Dashboard and Capex Financing Pressure
summary: AI 基础设施书 demand-risk 层的 RPO/backlog 仪表盘：Oracle 正从成熟数据库/企业软件公司变成高资本强度 AI 云基础设施平台。FY2026 Q4 收入 $19.18B(+21%)、OCI 收入 $5.8B(+93%)、RPO 达 $638B(+363%)，需求读数极强；但 FY2026 capex $55.66B、自由现金流 -$23.69B、FY2027 capex 指引可达 $90-95B，且公司需要约 $40B 债务+股权融资。以 2026-07-30 收盘 $127.56 计，市值约 $367B、净债务约 $124.30B、企业价值约 $492B，对应约 7.3x TTM EV/Sales 和约 21.9x EV/TTM 营业利润。20% 牛市 / 40% 基准 / 40% 熊市情景网格仍给出偏负预期差，立场维持谨慎 / 中确信；关键不是订单多不多，而是 RPO 能否按期转化为高回报现金流。
summaryEn: The RPO/backlog dashboard for the AI-infrastructure book's demand-risk layer: Oracle is changing from a mature database and enterprise-software company into a capital-intensive AI-cloud infrastructure platform. FY2026 Q4 revenue was $19.18B (+21%), OCI revenue was $5.8B (+93%), and RPO reached $638B (+363%), making the demand readout very strong. But FY2026 capex was $55.66B, free cash flow was -$23.69B, FY2027 capex could reach $90-95B, and the company expects roughly $40B of debt and equity financing. At the $127.56 close on Jul 30, 2026, roughly $367B market cap, about $124.30B net debt, and about $492B enterprise value, ORCL trades at about 7.3x TTM EV/Sales and about 21.9x EV/TTM operating income. The 20% bull / 40% base / 40% bear grid still leaves a negative expectation gap, so the stance stays cautious / medium conviction: the question is not whether orders are large, but whether RPO converts into high-return cash flow on schedule.
highlights: demand-risk 层的 RPO/backlog 仪表盘：FY2026 Q4 RPO $638B(+363%，环比 +$85B)，OCI 收入 $5.8B(+93%)，验证 AI 云需求是否穿透到订单簿
现金流和融资压力同样极端：FY2026 capex $55.66B、FCF -$23.69B；FY2027 capex 指引 $90-95B，另需约 $40B 债务+股权融资，含 $20B ATM 股权发行
2026-07-30 收盘 $127.56、约 $367B 市值、约 $124.30B 净债务、约 $492B 企业价值，对应约 7.3x TTM EV/Sales、约 21.9x EV/TTM 营业利润；传统软件利润表与 AI 基建资产负债表叙事并存
核心监控不是『订单多不多』，而是 RPO 转化、客户集中、OCI 毛利/ROIC、capex 是否按时变成可售 capacity，以及融资是否伤害股东

summary: 【2026-07-31 立场重新裁定：COHR 于 2026-07-30 收于 $249.06，较 07-29 低点反弹 +12.2%、较原锚点 -25.3%，市值约 $48.7B、EV/TTM sales 约 7.5x；按所有者 Q1 裁定，立场由谨慎调整为观望中性（低确信）。】AI 基础设施 optical 层核心光模块/光器件覆盖。Coherent 不是解释 GPU 单价，而是验证 AI 集群网络扩容是否真正穿透到高速光连接、激光器、InP/SiPh 与 CPO/NPO 路线。Q3 FY2026 收入 $1.81B（+21% YoY，pro forma +27%）、非 GAAP 毛利率 39.6%、非 GAAP EPS $1.41；Datacenter & Communications 收入约 $1.362B，占 pro forma 收入约 75%，同比约 +41%。NVIDIA 2026-03 宣布向 Coherent 投资 $2B，并包含多年、数十亿美元采购承诺和未来产能访问权；公司材料给出 1.6T/3.2T/6.4T ZR/ZR+、CPO/NPO、光电路交换与多轨热管理路线。按 2026-07-30 收盘：市值约 $48.7B、EV 约 $49.7B、EV/TTM sales 约 7.5x（旧口径 10.1x），隐含增速要求约 16-24%。观望中性 / 低确信：需求证据真实，旧的负预期差在当前价格下不再成立；Q3 FCF -$3.83 亿的现金流转化仍是主要约束。
